spec: Set DEPTH = 10 and ASPECT_RATIO = 51 so model_dim is about 512 (round to a multiple of HEAD_DIM per existing code). Deeper and same width; check throughput tradeoff.

title: Cosine-shaped warmdown
spec: Replace the linear warmdown in the LR schedule function with a cosine shape: lr_mult = 0.5*(1+cos(pi*progress)) over the warmdown phase.

title: Gradient clipping 1.0
spec: Add torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(model.parameters(), 1.0) before optimizer step, to stabilize with higher LRs.

title: Head dim 64
spec: Set HEAD_DIM = 64 giving twice as many heads at the same width. May improve quality; check flash/SDPA speed.

title: Shorter warmdown ratio 0.3
spec: Change WARMDOWN_RATIO from 0.5 to 0.3 so more of the budget is spent at peak LR.

title: Short LR warmup
spec: Set WARMUP_RATIO = 0.02 so the LR ramps linearly from 0 to full over the first 2% of the time budget, protecting early Muon/Adam steps at the high embedding LR. Nothing else changes.

title: Weight decay 0.1 with linear decay to zero
spec: Set WEIGHT_DECAY = 0.1 and make the Muon cautious weight decay decay with progress, i.e. multiplied by (1 - progress) each step, so regularization fades as training ends. Minimal edit in the per-step schedule update code.

title: Bolder: untied-scale init and smaller embedding init
spec: Reduce the token embedding init std by half (e.g. normal std 0.5 instead of 1.0, or whatever the current value is divided by 2) and compensate by leaving EMBEDDING_LR unchanged. Also scale the lm_head init std by 0.5. This tests whether lower initial logit and residual magnitude speeds early training in the short 300 s budget.

title: Stronger init shrink combined with embedding LR 0.4
spec: Keep the halved token embedding init std (0.5) and lm_head init std (0.0005) from the earlier near-win, which gave 1.0635, and also set EMBEDDING_LR to 0.4. This tests whether the smaller embedding init pairs better with a lower embedding LR.

title: Final LR fraction 0.05
spec: Set FINAL_LR_FRAC from 0.0 to 0.05 so the warmdown ends at 5% of peak LR rather than zero. No other changes.

title: Head dim 64
spec: Set HEAD_DIM = 64 for more attention heads at the same width.

title: Gradient clipping 1.0
spec: Add torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(model.parameters(), 1.0) before the optimizer step to stabilise higher LR runs.

title: Depth 6 wider
spec: Set DEPTH = 6 and ASPECT_RATIO = 96 (model_dim 576 is divisible by HEAD_DIM 128? use 640 via ASPECT_RATIO=107 if needed, else dim 512 with ASPECT_RATIO 85 rounded to multiple of 128). Fewer layers gives more steps in 300 s.

title: Lower total batch to 2**18
spec: Set TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE = 2**18 (keep DEVICE_BATCH_SIZE 64 so grad accumulation halves). In a 300 s budget more optimizer steps usually help a small model. Keep all other hyperparameters unchanged.

title: Depth 7
spec: Set DEPTH = 7 to trade model size for more training steps in the fixed time; ASPECT_RATIO 73 to give dim 512.

title: Scalar LR 0.25
spec: Halve SCALAR_LR from 0.5 to 0.25.

title: Adam beta2 0.99
spec: Change ADAM_BETAS to (0.8, 0.99) for smoother second-moment estimates on embeddings.

title: Window pattern all L
spec: Change WINDOW_PATTERN to "L" to use full context everywhere and see whether quality outweighs speed.

title: Warmdown ratio 0.3
spec: Change WARMDOWN_RATIO from 0.5 to 0.3 so more time is spent at full LR.

title: Warmdown ratio 0.7
spec: Change WARMDOWN_RATIO from 0.5 to 0.7.

title: Batch 2**17 tokens
spec: Set TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE = 2**17 so each optimizer step uses ~131K tokens (grad accumulation 1 with DEVICE_BATCH_SIZE 64 at seq len 2048). Batch reduction has been the only clear win; leave all other hyperparameters unchanged.

title: Batch size ramp
spec: Make the effective batch size grow during training: use 2**17 tokens per step for the first ~30% of the time budget, then 2**18 afterwards (switch the grad accumulation steps from 1 to 2 at that point). Keep the LR schedule time-based as is. Small early batches give more steps when the loss falls quickly.

title: Short warmup
spec: Set WARMUP_RATIO = 0.03 to smooth early Muon/Adam steps, especially if combined with the higher LRs.

title: ReLU^2 MLP to SwiGLU
spec: If MLP uses relu squared, replace with SwiGLU with hidden dim 8/3*d rounded to a multiple of 64 so parameters match.

title: Deeper, narrower: depth 10 at dim 384
spec: Set DEPTH=10 and ASPECT_RATIO=38 (dim 380, rounded up to 384 by the head_dim rounding, 3 heads of 128). Check that throughput stays high. This is a bolder shape change that keeps the parameter count similar while trading width for depth.

title: Zero-init residual projections plus smaller init
spec: Initialise the attention output projection and MLP down projection weights to zero, if they are not already. Scale the init std of the other matrices by 0.8. This makes early training more stable and may allow a higher LR.

title: Matrix LR 0.05
spec: Raise MATRIX_LR from 0.04 to 0.05.

title: Final LR fraction 0.05
spec: Set FINAL_LR_FRAC to 0.05 so the warmdown ends at 5% of peak LR instead of 0. Keep every other setting unchanged.

title: ReLU^2 to SwiGLU-lite check
spec: If MLP uses relu squared, replace with SwiGLU with hidden size 8/3*dim rounded to multiple of 64 to keep params equal.

title: Depth 6 wider-aspect
spec: Set DEPTH = 6 and ASPECT_RATIO = 85 (dim ≈ 512, multiple of HEAD_DIM 128 → 512) to trade depth for throughput; more steps in 300 s.

title: Depth 10
spec: Set DEPTH = 10 with ASPECT_RATIO 64 (dim 640, 5 heads); check whether the larger model wins despite fewer steps. Reduce DEVICE_BATCH_SIZE to 32 if OOM.

title: Embedding LR 0.4
spec: Lower EMBEDDING_LR from 0.6 to 0.4.

title: Head dim 64
spec: Set HEAD_DIM = 64 giving twice as many heads; may improve quality at similar cost.

title: Warmdown ratio 0.7
spec: Set WARMDOWN_RATIO = 0.7 for longer decay phase.

title: Zero-init projections and smaller init
spec: Ensure attention and MLP output projections are zero-initialized; scale embedding init std to 0.5 if currently 1.0.

title: Adam beta2 0.99
spec: Change ADAM_BETAS to (0.8, 0.99) for smoother second moment estimates.

title: Short warmup
spec: Set WARMUP_RATIO = 0.03 to stabilize early training with Muon and high Adam LRs.

title: Weight decay 0.05
spec: Set WEIGHT_DECAY = 0.05. A small model trained for few tokens is underfitting rather than overfitting, so less cautious decay on Muon may help.

title: Total batch 2**17
spec: Set TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE = 2**17 with DEVICE_BATCH_SIZE 64 (accumulation 1 step of 2 micro-batches of 64x2048). Many more steps; may need MATRIX_LR tweak but test as is.

title: Lower logit softcap
spec: Reduce the logit softcap constant (the value used in tanh softcapping of the logits, likely 15) to 8. Keep the rest of the forward pass unchanged. It tests whether tighter logit bounds help the short-training regime.

title: Weight decay 0.1
spec: Lower Muon WEIGHT_DECAY to 0.1.

title: Gradient clipping 1.0
spec: Add torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(model.parameters(), 1.0) before optimizer step to stabilize at higher LRs.

title: Warmdown ratio 0.3
spec: Set WARMDOWN_RATIO = 0.3 so more time is spent at peak LR.

title: Unembedding LR 0.008
spec: Double UNEMBEDDING_LR to 0.008.

title: Batch 2**17 with lower matrix LR
spec: Set TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE = 2**17 and MATRIX_LR = 0.03. Bolder small-batch regime for many more optimizer steps in 300 s; reduce LR to keep Muon stable at the noisier gradient.

title: Depth 4 with dim 768
spec: Set DEPTH=4 and ASPECT_RATIO=192 (model_dim 768, 6 heads of 128). Fewer, wider layers give faster steps and so more tokens in 300 s at the small batch. Leave other hyperparameters unchanged.

title: Final LR fraction 0.05
spec: Set FINAL_LR_FRAC from 0.0 to 0.05 so the LR does not decay fully to zero at the end of warmdown. Change nothing else.

title: Untied-norm: add QK norm scale
spec: Multiply the normalized q and k by a constant 1.2 (a sharper attention temperature) after the QK RMS norm. Keep it a single constant in the attention forward.

title: Embedding LR 0.4
spec: Lower EMBEDDING_LR from 0.6 to 0.4 to check for over-aggressive embedding updates.

title: Window pattern all short plus final long
spec: Change WINDOW_PATTERN to "SSSSL" or "SSL" variants. Try "SSL" to give more full-context layers, or "SSSS" to speed up attention. Choose "SSSS" with the last layer forced long, which the code usually does.

title: Adam beta1 0.9
spec: Change ADAM_BETAS to (0.9, 0.95) to test whether more momentum helps embeddings.

title: Head dim 64
spec: Set HEAD_DIM = 64 for twice as many heads at the same width. Check that the code derives n_head from model_dim // HEAD_DIM and that flash attention supports it.

title: Weight decay 0.1
spec: Reduce Muon cautious WEIGHT_DECAY from 0.2 to 0.1. Short runs may not need strong regularization.

title: Lower total batch to 2**18
spec: Set TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE = 2**18 (keep DEVICE_BATCH_SIZE 64 so grad accumulation halves). With only 300 s of training, more optimizer steps usually help a small model. Leave the LR schedule unchanged.

title: Disable torch compile recompile overhead: fixed-shape eval-free loop

title: Muon NS steps 3 for speed

title: Sequence-length curriculum
spec: Early in training, use only the first half of each sequence for the loss and input (for example, crop x and y to length T/2 for the first 25% of the time budget, then use full T). This gives more tokens per second early. Keep the compiled model shapes limited to two variants by marking the shape change once, and make sure the final evaluation call is untouched.

title: Full-attention everywhere
spec: Set WINDOW_PATTERN = "L" to test if full context everywhere helps despite the speed cost.

title: Matrix LR 0.05
spec: Increase MATRIX_LR from 0.04 to 0.05.

title: Logit softcap tweak
spec: Change the logit softcap value (likely 15) to 30, or remove it, in the forward pass.

title: Cosine-shaped warmdown
spec: Replace the linear warmdown with a cosine shape: multiplier = 0.5*(1+cos(pi*t)) over the warmdown fraction.

title: Gradient clipping at 1.0
spec: Add torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(model.parameters(), 1.0) before optimizer step to stabilize at high LRs.

title: Muon momentum warmup shorter/higher
spec: Raise final Muon momentum to 0.97 and reach it by step ~100 rather than the current ramp (edit the momentum schedule function).

title: Depth 6 wider-faster
spec: Set DEPTH = 6 (model_dim 384 → consider ASPECT_RATIO 96 to keep width 576) so more steps fit in 300s; verify head count divides dim by HEAD_DIM.

title: Head dim 64
spec: Set HEAD_DIM = 64 for more attention heads at same width.

title: EMA of weights for final model
spec: Maintain an exponential moving average of the model parameters (decay 0.999, updated every step with torch._foreach_lerp_ in no_grad) and copy the EMA weights into the model after training ends, before the evaluation call. Keep the copy simple and do not touch the evaluation code.

title: Warmdown ratio 0.3
spec: Change WARMDOWN_RATIO to 0.3 so more time is spent at peak LR.

title: Sequence length 1024 with doubled device batch
spec: Halve MAX_SEQ_LEN (or the equivalent sequence-length constant) to 1024. Keep tokens per step at 2**19 by letting the loop's accumulation logic recompute the steps. Set DEVICE_BATCH_SIZE to 64, which now uses half the memory. Shorter sequences make attention cheaper, so throughput should rise. Adjust the window sizes in WINDOW_PATTERN if they are hard-coded against the sequence length.

title: Batch 2**18 with more steps
spec: Change TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE from 2**19 to 2**18 so that gradient accumulation halves and the model takes about twice as many optimizer steps in the fixed 300 s. Keep DEVICE_BATCH_SIZE at 64. Leave all LRs unchanged. In a short time budget, more steps usually beat larger batches.

title: SwiGLU-style gated MLP
spec: Replace the ReLU^2 MLP with a gated MLP: out = c_proj(F.silu(c_gate(x)) * c_fc(x)). The hidden width is 8/3 * n_embd, rounded to a multiple of 64, so the parameter count stays near that of the 4x MLP. Initialize c_gate like c_fc. Make sure the new matrix is included in the Muon parameter group.

title: Smaller batch with more steps: 2**18 and device batch 32 accumulation
spec: Set TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE to 2**18 and keep DEVICE_BATCH_SIZE 64 (grad accumulation halves). In a 300 s budget this gives about twice as many optimizer steps. Also scale MATRIX_LR by 0.85 to compensate for noisier gradients. Change nothing else.

title: Clip grad norm 1.0 plus warmdown 0.3
spec: Combine the two best single-run results. Set WARMDOWN_RATIO = 0.3 and add torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(model.parameters(), 1.0) after the backward passes and before the optimizer step. Leave everything else unchanged.

title: Final LR fraction 0.05
spec: Set FINAL_LR_FRAC = 0.05 so the LR does not reach exactly zero at the end of warmdown. Keep WARMDOWN_RATIO at 0.5. This is a tiny, low-risk schedule tweak.

title: Short warmup
spec: Set WARMUP_RATIO = 0.02 to stabilize early Muon/Adam steps at high LRs.

title: Depth 10
spec: Set DEPTH = 10 with ASPECT_RATIO 64 (dim 640, 5 heads). Check whether the extra capacity beats lost steps.

title: Warmdown ratio 0.7
spec: Set WARMDOWN_RATIO to 0.7 so the LR decays linearly over the last 70% of the time budget. Warmdown 0.3 was only slightly better than 0.5, so test the opposite direction. Change nothing else.

title: ReLU squared to SwiGLU-lite
spec: Replace the MLP activation relu(x)^2 with a gated unit: use two projections of hidden size 8/3*dim and multiply silu(gate) by up. Keep the parameter count roughly equal.

title: Gradient clipping 1.0
spec: Add torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(model.parameters(), 1.0) before the optimizer step for stability at a higher LR.

title: Muon momentum warmup shortened
spec: If Muon momentum is ramped from ~0.85 to 0.95, shorten the ramp to the first 100 steps and set the final momentum to 0.97 for the later part of training.

title: Weight decay 0.1
spec: Lower WEIGHT_DECAY from 0.2 to 0.1. With a short run, less regularization may help.

title: Time-based LR schedule cosine warmdown
spec: Replace the linear warmdown with a cosine shape: lr multiplier = FINAL_LR_FRAC + (1-FINAL_LR_FRAC)*0.5*(1+cos(pi*(1-progress_in_warmdown))). Keep the same WARMDOWN_RATIO.

title: Scalar LR 0.25
spec: Lower SCALAR_LR from 0.5 to 0.25 to stabilize the per-layer scalars.

title: Embedding weight decay-free and lm_head LR bump with softcap 20
spec: Set the logit softcap value from its current value (probably 15 or 30) to 20, and raise UNEMBEDDING_LR from 0.004 to 0.006. This is one combined output-layer tweak. It tests whether the output layer under-trains in the short budget.

title: Quarter total batch size
spec: Set TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE = 2**17 with DEVICE_BATCH_SIZE 64 (accumulation 2 steps if the code allows). Check that the grad-accum computation still divides evenly. Also scale MATRIX_LR down slightly to 0.035 for stability.

title: Untied-scale: learnable residual stream skip to input embedding
spec: Make sure each layer has a learned scalar mixing of the initial embedding x0 into the residual stream (x = lambda_r*x + lambda_0*x0). If it already exists, initialize lambda_0 to 0.2 instead of the current value and give it its own lr of SCALAR_LR*0.5. Otherwise add it. This is a small change to the forward pass and the optimizer param groups.

title: Depth 6 wider-per-step
spec: Set DEPTH = 6 (model_dim 384 with ASPECT_RATIO 64). A smaller model trains more tokens in 300 s. Ensure the dim is a multiple of HEAD_DIM, and raise ASPECT_RATIO to 85 if needed so dim is 512 (round to a multiple of 128).

title: Depth 6 with wider model (ASPECT_RATIO 96)
spec: Set DEPTH=6 and ASPECT_RATIO=96 so model_dim is 576, rounded to a multiple of HEAD_DIM (128 gives 512 or 640; adjust ASPECT_RATIO so dim is divisible by 128, e.g. 107 gives 642 -> use 640). A shallower, wider net runs faster per step on an A100 and gets more tokens within 300 s.

title: Warmdown ratio 0.3
spec: Change WARMDOWN_RATIO from 0.5 to 0.3, so more of the run is spent at peak LR.

title: Warmdown ratio 0.7
spec: Change WARMDOWN_RATIO from 0.5 to 0.7 to give a longer decay.

title: Smaller total batch with more steps (2**18)
spec: Set TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE to 2**18 (about 262K tokens per step) so grad accumulation halves, which gives roughly twice as many optimizer steps in the fixed 300 s. Keep DEVICE_BATCH_SIZE at 64. Scale MATRIX_LR by about 0.85 only if the code has no automatic scaling. The 300 s budget is short, so more steps may beat larger batches.

title: Final LR fraction 0.05
spec: Set FINAL_LR_FRAC = 0.05 so the warmdown ends at 5% of the peak LR rather than 0. Keep WARMDOWN_RATIO 0.5. Tests whether a nonzero floor helps late-stage learning under the time-based schedule.

title: Matrix LR 0.05
spec: Increase MATRIX_LR from 0.04 to 0.05.

title: ReLU squared to SwiGLU
spec: Replace the MLP activation with SwiGLU, using hidden dim of about 8/3*dim rounded to a multiple of 64 so the parameter count stays the same.

title: Unembedding LR 0.008
spec: Set UNEMBEDDING_LR = 0.008, doubling the lm_head Adam LR.

title: Muon momentum warmup tweak
spec: Raise the final Muon momentum from its current value to 0.97 (or to 0.98 if it is already 0.95), keeping the existing ramp schedule.

title: Lower total batch to 2**18
spec: Set TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE = 2**18 so that with a 300 s budget the model takes about twice as many optimizer steps. Keep DEVICE_BATCH_SIZE 64 (grad accumulation halves). Adjust nothing else.

title: Cosine warmdown shape
spec: Replace the linear warmdown with a cosine shape: multiplier = FINAL_LR_FRAC + (1-FINAL_LR_FRAC)*0.5*(1+cos(pi*t)), where t is the progress through the warmdown phase.

title: Matrix LR 0.05
spec: Set MATRIX_LR = 0.05 for Muon.

title: Final LR fraction 0.05
spec: Set FINAL_LR_FRAC = 0.05 so the LR does not reach exactly zero at the end.

title: Batch 2**17 with scaled LRs
spec: Set TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE = 2**17 and multiply MATRIX_LR by 0.8 to compensate for noise. Keep DEVICE_BATCH_SIZE 64 (or 32 if grad accumulation divisibility requires it).

title: Warmdown ratio 0.7
spec: Set WARMDOWN_RATIO = 0.7 so the LR decays linearly over the last 70% of the time budget.

title: Gradient clipping 1.0
spec: Add torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(model.parameters(), 1.0) before the optimizer step to limit rare loss spikes.

title: Embedding LR 0.4
spec: Set EMBEDDING_LR = 0.4.

title: Short warmup 2%
spec: Set WARMUP_RATIO = 0.02 to stabilize the first steps, which may allow a higher LR.

title: Muon momentum warmup shorter
spec: Shorten the Muon momentum ramp (e.g. 0.85 to 0.95) from 300 steps to 100 steps. If a ramp does not exist, add one from 0.85 to 0.95 over the first 100 steps.

title: Short warmup
spec: Set WARMUP_RATIO = 0.03 to add a brief LR warmup and stabilize early Muon/Adam steps.

title: Warmdown ratio 0.7
spec: Set WARMDOWN_RATIO = 0.7 so the LR decays linearly over the last 70% of the time budget.

title: Total batch 2**17
spec: Set TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE = 2**17 (grad accumulation of 2 at device batch 64). Many more steps in the fixed time budget; consider lowering MATRIX_LR to 0.03 if unstable, but only change the batch size first.

title: Weight decay 0.1
spec: Set WEIGHT_DECAY = 0.1 for cautious Muon weight decay. Short runs may benefit from less decay.

title: Adam beta2 0.98
spec: Set ADAM_BETAS = (0.8, 0.98) for a smoother second-moment estimate.

title: Window pattern all-long final only
spec: Set WINDOW_PATTERN = "SSSSL" or "SL" variants. Try "SL", which has more full-context layers, and check whether quality gains outweigh the speed cost.

title: Warmdown ratio 0.3
spec: Set WARMDOWN_RATIO = 0.3 to keep the LR high longer.

title: Matrix LR 0.05
spec: Set MATRIX_LR = 0.05 for the Muon parameters.

title: Depth 6 wider-per-time
spec: Set DEPTH = 6 (model_dim = 384 with ASPECT_RATIO 64; consider ASPECT_RATIO 96 to keep the width at 576 and keep the head dim a divisor). A smaller model gets more tokens in 300 s.

title: Depth 10
spec: Set DEPTH = 10 with the same aspect ratio. Check whether the larger model beats the lower token count in 300 s. Reduce DEVICE_BATCH_SIZE to 32 if OOM.

title: Total batch 2**15 with scaled LRs
spec: Set TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE = 2**15 and DEVICE_BATCH_SIZE = 32 so no accumulation is needed. Multiply MATRIX_LR, EMBEDDING_LR and UNEMBEDDING_LR by 0.7 to compensate for the noisier gradients. This is a bolder step along the small-batch direction.

title: Final LR fraction 0.1 with cosine decay
spec: Replace the linear warmdown with a cosine shape over the same WARMDOWN_RATIO of 0.5. Set the multiplier to FINAL_LR_FRAC + (1-FINAL_LR_FRAC)*0.5*(1+cos(pi*p)), where p is progress through the warmdown, and set FINAL_LR_FRAC = 0.05. This changes the decay shape, not just the length.

title: Batch size ramp
spec: Make the batch size grow during training. For the first 30% of the time budget use 2**15 tokens per step, then switch to 2**17 for the rest. Implement it by changing the number of gradient accumulation micro-steps based on training progress. Scale the LR by sqrt(batch ratio) at the switch only if training is unstable. Early steps are cheap and noisy gradients are fine there, while the larger batch helps convergence later.

title: Muon momentum 0.9 final
spec: Lower the final Muon momentum from the current value (likely 0.95) to 0.9, and keep the warmup ramp. With small batches and many steps, lower momentum reduces staleness of the update direction. Edit only the momentum target in the Muon momentum schedule function.

title: Muon momentum final 0.9 with Muon ns steps 3
spec: Lower the Muon final momentum from its current value (likely 0.95) to 0.9, and reduce the Newton-Schulz iteration count from 5 to 4 if the code exposes it as a parameter. This allows faster response and cheaper steps, which gives a few more steps in the fixed 300 s. If the ns steps are hard-coded in a way that needs a larger edit, only change the momentum.

title: Head dim 64
spec: Set HEAD_DIM = 64 so the model has 8 heads at dim 512 instead of 4. Leave everything else unchanged. Check that the number of KV heads and the value-embedding head logic derive from the head count rather than hard-coded values.

title: Lower embedding and unembedding LR balance
spec: Set EMBEDDING_LR = 0.3 and UNEMBEDDING_LR = 0.008 together. The embedding LR of 0.6 was tuned for large batches. At 4x more steps, a smaller embedding step and a larger lm_head step may balance better.

title: Unembedding LR 0.008
spec: Set UNEMBEDDING_LR = 0.008, doubling the lm_head learning rate.

title: Warmdown ratio 0.3
spec: Set WARMDOWN_RATIO = 0.3 to retain more high-LR training time.

title: Short warmup
spec: Set WARMUP_RATIO = 0.03 to stabilize early Muon and Adam steps at higher LRs.

title: Depth 6 wider-per-time
spec: Set DEPTH = 6 (model dim 384 with ASPECT_RATIO 64); a smaller model trains more tokens in 300 s. Consider raising ASPECT_RATIO to 96 to keep width.

title: Window pattern all long except tail short
spec: Set WINDOW_PATTERN = "SSSSL" or "L" variants; try "SL" to test whether more full-context layers help.

title: Muon momentum warmup tune
spec: Adjust Muon momentum schedule: ramp from 0.85 to 0.97 over the first 300 steps, then hold 0.95 during warmdown if applicable.

title: Unembedding LR 0.008
spec: Double UNEMBEDDING_LR from 0.004 to 0.008.

title: Head dim 64
spec: Set HEAD_DIM = 64 for more attention heads at same width.

title: Untie and learnable per-head attention scaling with QK-norm temperature
spec: If the attention uses QK-norm (rms norm on q and k), add a learnable scalar per head (init 1.2, in the Adam scalar group at SCALAR_LR) multiplying q after normalization, replacing the fixed softmax scale. If it does not use QK-norm, add rms norm to q and k first. Small code change aimed at sharper attention.

title: Cosine-free linear warmdown to nonzero floor with EMA of weights
spec: Maintain an exponential moving average of model parameters (decay 0.999, updated every step in a separate fp32 copy or bf16 buffer using torch._foreach_lerp_). At the end of training, before the evaluation call, copy the EMA weights into the model. Keep everything else unchanged. This is a small amount of code and often lowers final loss in short runs.

title: Depth 10
spec: Set DEPTH = 10 with ASPECT_RATIO 64; test if a larger model wins despite fewer steps. Reduce DEVICE_BATCH_SIZE to 32 if memory demands.

title: Combine UNEMBEDDING_LR 0.008 with WARMDOWN_RATIO 0.3
spec: Change UNEMBEDDING_LR from 0.004 to 0.008 and WARMDOWN_RATIO from 0.5 to 0.3 in one run. These were two of the best small single wins. This tests whether the gains add up before any replicate.

title: Pure short window attention except last layer
spec: Set WINDOW_PATTERN so all layers use the short window (half context) except the final layer, which stays full. For example, use a pattern string of 'SSSSSSSL' for depth 8, assuming the code forces the last layer to be long. Cheaper attention means more steps in the fixed time. Check that the window-size construction handles the string.

title: Total batch 2**17
spec: Set TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE = 2**17 with DEVICE_BATCH_SIZE 64 (grad accum 1 if seq len 2048 gives 131k tokens per 64 seqs; otherwise adjust). Many more steps; consider scaling MATRIX_LR down slightly to 0.03.

title: Replace ReLU^2 MLP with SwiGLU at matched params
spec: Replace the MLP with a SwiGLU: three linear layers (gate, up, down) with hidden size round(8/3*dim) rounded to a multiple of 128, output y = down(silu(gate(x))*up(x)). Zero-init the down projection as the current c_proj is. Make sure all new matrices are included in the Muon parameter group.

title: Warmdown ratio 0.7
spec: Set WARMDOWN_RATIO = 0.7 to anneal over more of the run.

title: Sequence-length curriculum
spec: For the first 30% of the time budget, train on sequences truncated to half length. Do this by slicing each batch's inputs and targets to the first T/2 positions, and keep the tokens per step constant by using the same number of micro-batches. After 30% use full length. Use a fixed set of shapes to avoid repeated recompiles; if the model is compiled, mark it dynamic=False and accept one recompile. Early steps get cheaper, so there are more steps in the budget.

title: Batch-size ramp
spec: Use a smaller batch early. Set grad accumulation steps so the first 25% of the time budget uses TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE/4 tokens per optimizer step, then 2x for the next 25%, then the full 2**19. Scale the loss by the current number of micro-steps. Keep LR unchanged. This gives many more early updates when gradients are noisy-insensitive and costs no extra code complexity beyond a step-size function.

title: Depth 10 narrower
spec: Set DEPTH = 10 with ASPECT_RATIO = 51 (dim rounded to multiple of 128 by the code) to test a deeper model at similar params; check throughput tradeoff.

title: Gradient clipping 1.0
spec: Add torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(model.parameters(), 1.0) before optimizer step to damp spikes.

title: Muon momentum warmup shorter/higher
spec: In the Muon momentum schedule, ramp momentum to 0.97 at the end of warmup, and reach 0.95 sooner (over first 100 steps), then drop to 0.90 during warmdown.

title: Short LR warmup
spec: Set WARMUP_RATIO = 0.03 to stabilize the early steps of Muon/Adam with high LRs.

title: Head dim 64
spec: Set HEAD_DIM = 64 giving more attention heads; may improve quality at the same cost with flash attention.

title: Depth 6 wider
spec: Set DEPTH = 6 and ASPECT_RATIO = 96 (model_dim 576, ensure divisible by HEAD_DIM 128 -> use ASPECT_RATIO 85.33 not allowed; use ASPECT_RATIO=107 giving 642? Instead choose ASPECT_RATIO=100 and round dim up to a multiple of HEAD_DIM as the code does). Fewer, wider layers give faster steps under the time budget.

title: Warmdown ratio 0.3
spec: Set WARMDOWN_RATIO = 0.3 so more of the time is spent at peak LR.

title: Matrix LR 0.05
spec: Raise MATRIX_LR to 0.05 for Muon.

title: Muon LR 0.06 with weight decay 0.1
spec: Bolder joint optimizer change: set MATRIX_LR = 0.06 and WEIGHT_DECAY = 0.1. A larger step with less decay may suit the short 300 s budget.

title: Weight averaging (EMA) for eval
spec: Maintain an EMA copy of the model parameters with decay 0.999, updated every step after the first 20% of training, using torch._foreach_lerp_. Swap the EMA weights into the model right before the final evaluation call, without touching the evaluation call itself. This costs one extra parameter copy.

title: Depth 6 with doubled width
spec: Set DEPTH = 6 and ASPECT_RATIO = 128 so model_dim is 768 and HEAD_DIM 128 gives 6 heads. This is a shallower, wider model which has higher throughput per token. If VRAM is a problem, keep DEVICE_BATCH_SIZE at 64 or reduce it to 32 and let grad accumulation compensate.

title: Warmdown ratio 0.7
spec: Set WARMDOWN_RATIO = 0.7 for a longer decay phase.

title: Embedding LR 0.9 and unembedding LR 0.008
spec: Raise EMBEDDING_LR from 0.6 to 0.9 and UNEMBEDDING_LR from 0.004 to 0.008 together, to test whether the Adam-trained parameters are undertrained in the short 300 s budget. Leave MATRIX_LR unchanged.

title: Sequence-length curriculum
spec: For the first 30% of the time budget train with sequences truncated to 512 tokens, by reshaping each batch to (B*4, 512) while keeping the token count per step, then switch to the full 2048. This gives cheaper attention early and more steps. The sliding window sizes are unchanged. Disable the torch.compile recompile cost by marking dynamic shapes or accepting a single recompile, which is not counted in startup.

title: Lower total batch to 2**18
spec: Set TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE = 2**18 (keep DEVICE_BATCH_SIZE 64 so grad accumulation drops from 4 to 2 steps/step... i.e. twice as many optimizer steps in the fixed 300 s). Small models in short budgets usually benefit from more steps.

title: Window pattern all short except last layer
spec: Change WINDOW_PATTERN to "SSSSSSSL" for DEPTH 8 so only the final layer uses full context and the other layers use half-context windows. This cuts attention compute and may give more steps in 300 s. Make sure the last layer is always full attention.

title: Cosine warmdown to 10% floor
spec: Replace the linear warmdown with a cosine decay over the final 50% of time, going from 1.0 to FINAL_LR_FRAC=0.05. Edit the get_lr_multiplier function only.

title: Dropout-free token noise regularization: label smoothing 0.05
spec: In the training loss only (not evaluation), compute cross-entropy with label_smoothing=0.05. Make sure the eval path continues to use its own unsmoothed loss. If the shared model forward owns the loss, add a flag used only when training.

title: Matrix LR 0.05
spec: Raise MATRIX_LR from 0.04 to 0.05 for faster Muon learning in the short budget.

title: Cosine warmdown shape
spec: Replace the linear warmdown with a cosine-shaped decay to final LR.

title: Depth 6 wider-per-time
spec: Set DEPTH = 6 (model_dim = 384 with ASPECT_RATIO 64; consider ASPECT_RATIO 96 to get dim 576, keeping HEAD_DIM 128 divisibility). A smaller model sees more tokens in 300 s.

title: Small warmup
spec: Set WARMUP_RATIO = 0.03 to stabilize the first steps of Muon and Adam, allowing the other high LRs to work better.

title: Residual lambda init 0.9
spec: Initialize per-layer residual scale lambdas to 0.9 and x0 skip lambdas to 0.2 instead of the current values.

title: Weight decay 0.1
spec: Reduce Muon cautious WEIGHT_DECAY from 0.2 to 0.1, since the run is short and underfitting.

title: Matrix LR 0.03
spec: Lower MATRIX_LR from 0.04 to 0.03 to test whether current LR is too high.

title: Adam beta2 0.99
spec: Change ADAM_BETAS to (0.8, 0.99) for smoother second-moment estimates on embeddings and scalars.

title: Multi-token prediction auxiliary loss
spec: Add an auxiliary loss predicting the token 2 positions ahead from the final hidden state. Use a small extra linear head (n_embd to vocab) or reuse lm_head after a lightweight learned projection of the final hidden state. Weight its cross-entropy at 0.3 and linearly anneal the weight to 0 over the warmdown. The reported and evaluated loss path must remain the standard next-token head only. Do not touch the evaluation call.

title: Replace ReLU^2 MLP with gated ReLU^2 at equal params
spec: Change the MLP to a gated form: out = proj(relu(gate(x))^2 * up(x)). Set the hidden size to about 8/3*n_embd, rounded to a multiple of 128, so the parameter count stays near the baseline's 4x ReLU^2 MLP. Initialize proj to zero as before, and put gate and up under Muon with the other matrices.

title: Lower total batch to 2**18
spec: Set TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE = 2**18 (keep DEVICE_BATCH_SIZE 64 so grad accumulation halves). With only 300 s of training, more optimizer steps usually help a small model. Leave all other hyperparameters unchanged.

title: Unembedding LR 0.008
spec: Double UNEMBEDDING_LR from 0.004 to 0.008.

title: EMA of weights for evaluation
spec: Maintain an exponential moving average of all model parameters (decay 0.999, updated every step in fp32 on GPU). After training finishes and before the final evaluation call, copy the EMA weights into the model. Do not change the evaluation function. If warmdown already ends at zero LR, use decay 0.995 to limit lag.

title: Warmdown ratio 0.7
spec: Change WARMDOWN_RATIO from 0.5 to 0.7 to test a longer decay phase.

title: Stack init change with beta2 0.99
spec: Combine two earlier single-run wins: in init_weights set resid_lambdas to 0.9 and x0_lambdas to 0.2, and set ADAM_BETAS = (0.8, 0.99). Both ran below the incumbent. This tests whether the gains add up.

title: Warmdown ratio 0.3
spec: Change WARMDOWN_RATIO from 0.5 to 0.3 so more of the budget is spent at full LR.

title: Weight EMA for evaluation
spec: Keep an EMA copy of the model parameters with decay 0.999, updated every optimizer step with torch._foreach_lerp_ under no_grad. Just before the final evaluation call, copy the EMA weights into the model. Do not change the evaluation call itself. Start the EMA at the initial weights, or from step ~50 to avoid bias. Memory cost is small at this model size.

title: Embedding LR 0.4 with scalar LR 0.25
spec: Lower EMBEDDING_LR from 0.6 to 0.4 and SCALAR_LR from 0.5 to 0.25. With more steps from the small batch, the Adam-driven parameters may now be overshooting. Single combined change in the hyperparameter block.

title: Matrix LR 0.05
spec: Raise MATRIX_LR from 0.04 to 0.05 for Muon.

title: Short warmup
spec: Set WARMUP_RATIO = 0.03 to stabilize early Muon and Adam steps at the high LRs.

title: Weight decay 0.1
spec: Set WEIGHT_DECAY = 0.1, since short runs may be over-regularized by 0.2.

title: Adam beta2 0.99
spec: Change ADAM_BETAS to (0.8, 0.99) for smoother second-moment estimates.

title: Warmdown ratio 0.3
spec: Change WARMDOWN_RATIO from 0.5 to 0.3 so more time is spent at peak LR. Nothing else changes.

title: Depth 10
spec: Set DEPTH = 10 with ASPECT_RATIO = 51 (dim ≈ 512). It is deeper but similarly sized. Check that dim is a multiple of HEAD_DIM (round to 512).

title: Head dim 64
spec: Set HEAD_DIM = 64 to get twice as many heads. Check that the attention kernel supports it, and that the KV head count follows from n_head.

title: Gradient clipping at 1.0 for Adam params
spec: After loss.backward() and before optimizer.step(), call torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(model.parameters(), 1.0). Muon normalizes its own updates, so the clip mainly affects the embedding, lm_head and scalar parameters. This may stabilize the high EMBEDDING_LR of 0.6.

title: Time-based LR schedule with cosine warmdown
spec: Replace the linear warmdown shape with a cosine shape: multiplier = 0.5·(1+cos(pi·p)) over the warmdown phase, where p is the progress through that phase. FINAL_LR_FRAC is the floor.

title: Embedding LR 0.4
spec: Lower EMBEDDING_LR from 0.6 to 0.4 for the Adam token embeddings.

title: Muon momentum warmup shorter
spec: Shorten the Muon momentum ramp from 0.85 to 0.95 to the first 150 steps (or whatever it currently is, halved). Tune the ramp end to 0.95.

title: Depth 6 wider throughput
spec: Set DEPTH = 6 with ASPECT_RATIO = 85 (dim ≈ 512, rounded to a multiple of HEAD_DIM). A smaller model sees more tokens in 300 s. Ensure model_dim stays divisible by HEAD_DIM.

title: Total batch 2**17

title: Window pattern SSSSL short
spec: Set WINDOW_PATTERN = "SSSS", with the last layer forced to L if the code does that already. This is faster, so more tokens are seen.

title: Smaller batch 2**17 with lower Muon LR
spec: Set TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE = 2**17 so there are many more optimizer steps in the 300 s budget. Set MATRIX_LR = 0.03 to offset the noisier gradients. Keep DEVICE_BATCH_SIZE at 64.

title: SwiGLU MLP with matched params
spec: Replace the ReLU^2 MLP with a SwiGLU MLP: gate and up projections of hidden size round(8/3*n_embd) rounded to a multiple of 64, then a down projection. Use silu(gate)*up. Keep the down projection zero-init as before and keep all the new matrices in the Muon group. This keeps the parameter count about the same.

title: Total batch 2**18 with LR scaled
spec: Set TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE=2**18, which gives grad accumulation 2 at device batch 64 with seq len 2048 if the sequence length is 2048. Keep the other hyperparameters as they are. This sits between the two batch sizes already tested.

title: SwiGLU MLP with matched parameters
spec: Replace the ReLU^2 MLP with a SwiGLU MLP. Use a gate and an up projection of hidden size round(8/3*n_embd) rounded to a multiple of 64, then the down projection. Output is down(silu(gate(x)) * up(x)). Zero-init the down projection as before and make sure all matrices go to Muon.

title: Warmdown ratio 0.7
spec: Change WARMDOWN_RATIO to 0.7 for a longer decay phase, which often helps final loss at short budgets.

title: Combine small winners
spec: In train.py set EMBEDDING_LR = 0.4, MATRIX_LR = 0.05 and WARMDOWN_RATIO = 0.3 together in one run. Each gave a small single-run gain, so this tests whether the gains add up. No other changes.

title: Depth 6 with the same aspect ratio

title: Time-based LR schedule with cosine warmdown
spec: Replace the linear warmdown with a cosine shape: multiplier = FINAL_LR_FRAC + (1-FINAL_LR_FRAC) * 0.5 * (1 + cos(pi * progress_in_warmdown)). Keep the warmdown ratio.

title: Gradient clipping at 1.0
spec: Add torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(model.parameters(), 1.0) before optimizer.step to reduce spikes at high LR.

title: Untied-init scaling for lm_head smaller
spec: Initialize lm_head weights with std 0.5 times the current value (or 0.001 if it is currently zero-scale), so early logits are smaller and the loss starts closer to ln(V).

title: Weight decay 0.1
spec: Lower the Muon WEIGHT_DECAY from 0.2 to 0.1.

title: Short warmup 3%

title: Muon momentum warmup shorter or higher final

title: Weight averaging (EMA) of parameters for eval

title: Lower total batch to 2**18
spec: Set TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE = 2**18 (keep DEVICE_BATCH_SIZE 64 so grad accumulation halves). In a fixed 300 s budget, more optimizer steps usually help a small model. Leave the other hyperparameters unchanged.

title: Increase Muon weight decay to 0.3 with linear decay to zero
spec: Set WEIGHT_DECAY = 0.3 but scale the effective weight decay each step by the current LR multiplier (progress-based) so that it decays to zero during warmdown. If the code already scales it, just set the base value to 0.3. Opposite direction from the failed 0.1 test.

title: Z-loss on logits
spec: In the training loss, add 1e-4 * mean(logsumexp(logits.float(), dim=-1)**2) to the cross-entropy. Only apply it during training, not in the evaluation path. Compute it from the same logits used for the loss (after softcap). Regularizes logit magnitude.

title: Learning-rate warmdown to nonzero with 3% warmup and warmdown 0.65 combined
spec: Set WARMUP_RATIO = 0.03, WARMDOWN_RATIO = 0.65 and FINAL_LR_FRAC = 0.03 together, keeping the linear warmdown shape. This is a combined schedule change meant to be bolder than single-parameter tweaks already in the backlog.

title: HEAD_DIM 64
spec: Set HEAD_DIM = 64 for more attention heads at the same width. Check that the rotary and value-embedding code handles the new head count.

title: Unembedding LR 0.008 with Embedding LR 0.9
spec: Raise UNEMBEDDING_LR from 0.004 to 0.008 and EMBEDDING_LR from 0.6 to 0.9 together. This is a bolder step that tests whether the Adam parameter groups are under-trained in a 300 s budget.

title: Window pattern all-short except last layer
spec: Set WINDOW_PATTERN = "SSSSSSSL" for 8 layers so only the final layer uses full context, making attention cheaper and allowing more steps in 300 s. Make sure the last layer is always L as the code already enforces.

title: Depth 10

title: Warmdown ratio 0.3
spec: Change WARMDOWN_RATIO from 0.5 to 0.3 so more of the run is spent at full LR. Nothing else changes.

title: Matrix LR 0.05

title: Adam beta1 0.9

title: Total batch 2**17

spec: Add torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(model.parameters(), 1.0) before optimizer step for stability at higher LR.

spec: Set WARMUP_RATIO = 0.03 to stabilize early Muon/Adam steps.

title: Warmdown ratio 0.3
spec: Set WARMDOWN_RATIO = 0.3 so more training happens at full LR.

title: Warmdown ratio 0.7
spec: Set WARMDOWN_RATIO = 0.7 for a longer decay phase.

title: Window pattern all short except last layer
spec: Set WINDOW_PATTERN to "SSSS" so the code's rule makes the final layer full context. Check whether the code forces the last layer to long. If it does not, force it. Short windows speed up attention, so more steps fit in 300 s. Leave everything else unchanged.

title: Adam beta2 0.99
spec: Change ADAM_BETAS to (0.8, 0.99)... or if unstable keep 0.95; test the smoother second moment.

title: Muon Newton-Schulz 4 steps
spec: Reduce the number of Newton-Schulz iterations in the Muon orthogonalization from 5 to 4 (the ns_steps argument or the loop count). This lowers optimizer time per step, so more steps fit in 300 s. Keep the coefficients unchanged.

title: Depth 10
spec: Set DEPTH = 10 with ASPECT_RATIO 64 (dim 640, HEAD_DIM 128 → 5 heads). Test whether a larger model wins despite fewer steps.

title: Unembedding LR 0.008
spec: Double UNEMBEDDING_LR to 0.008.

title: Head dim 64

title: Embedding LR 0.3 with unembedding LR 0.008
spec: Set EMBEDDING_LR to 0.3 and UNEMBEDDING_LR to 0.008. The unembedding doubling was the best single tweak so far, and the token embedding LR of 0.6 may now be too high at the smaller batch size.

title: Cosine warmdown shape
spec: Change the LR schedule's warmdown from linear to cosine. During the warmdown phase, use the multiplier FINAL_LR_FRAC + (1 - FINAL_LR_FRAC) * 0.5 * (1 + cos(pi * (1 - r))), where r is the fraction of the warmdown phase that remains (1 at its start, 0 at its end). Keep WARMDOWN_RATIO at 0.5.

title: Halve weight decay to 0.1
spec: Set WEIGHT_DECAY to 0.1. With about 4x more steps than the original baseline, 0.2 may over-regularize a model that is trained for only 300 s.

title: Head dim 64
spec: Set HEAD_DIM = 64 so there are twice as many attention heads at the same width.

title: Time-based LR schedule with cosine warmdown
spec: Replace the linear warmdown with a cosine shape: multiplier = FINAL_LR_FRAC + (1-FINAL_LR_FRAC)*0.5*(1+cos(pi*t)) over the warmdown phase, where t is progress through the phase.

title: Lower total batch to 2**18
spec: Set TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE = 2**18 (keep DEVICE_BATCH_SIZE 64, so grad accumulation halves). In a 300 s budget more optimizer steps usually help a small model.

title: Lower total batch to 2**17

title: Warmdown ratio 0.7
spec: Change WARMDOWN_RATIO to 0.7 for a longer decay phase.

title: Weight decay 0.1
spec: Lower Muon WEIGHT_DECAY from 0.2 to 0.1.

title: Matrix LR 0.05
spec: Raise MATRIX_LR from 0.04 to 0.05.

title: Muon momentum 0.97 end

title: Warmdown ratio 0.3
spec: Change WARMDOWN_RATIO from 0.5 to 0.3 so more training time is spent at peak LR.

spec: Set WARMUP_RATIO = 0.02 to stabilize the early steps of Muon and Adam.

title: Scalar LR 0.25
spec: Halve SCALAR_LR from 0.5 to 0.25.

title: Fewer Newton-Schulz steps

title: Embedding LR 0.4
spec: Lower EMBEDDING_LR from 0.6 to 0.4.

title: Depth 10

title: Depth 6 with wider model

The goal is more steps per 300 s with a shallower, wider net. Keep all other hyperparameters unchanged. If the dim is not divisible by HEAD_DIM=128, use ASPECT_RATIO=107 or whichever value gives dim 640.

title: Final LR fraction 0.05 with batch 2**17
spec: Set FINAL_LR_FRAC = 0.05 and TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE = 2**17 together. The lower LR floor avoids wasting the last steps at zero LR, and the smaller batch gives more steps.

title: Short warmup plus higher matrix LR at small batch
spec: Set WARMUP_RATIO = 0.03 and MATRIX_LR = 0.05 together. The 2**18 batch gave more steps, so a brief warmup should stabilize the higher Muon LR. Keep TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE at 2**18.

title: Lower total batch to 2**18

title: Total batch 2**17
spec: Set TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE = 2**17 with DEVICE_BATCH_SIZE 64 (grad accum becomes 1 or less than 1 depending on sequence length; adjust so it divides). Many more steps in the fixed time budget. Consider lowering MATRIX_LR slightly to 0.03 if unstable.

title: Scalar LR 0.25

title: Short warmup
spec: Set WARMUP_RATIO = 0.03 to stabilise the early high-LR Muon/Adam steps.

title: EMA of weights for evaluation
spec: Maintain an exponential moving average of the model parameters (decay 0.999, updated every step with torch._foreach_lerp_ in fp32 copies) and swap the EMA weights in just before the final evaluation call, without altering the evaluation call itself. This is cheap and often lowers the final loss when LR is not fully annealed.

title: Muon momentum 0.97 plateau
spec: Raise the Muon final momentum from the current value (likely 0.95) to 0.97 and extend its warmup ramp from 0.85 to that value over the first 500 steps. Leave the other parameters unchanged.

title: Depth 6

title: Weight decay 0.1

title: Depth 6 with wider dim

title: Z-loss on logits

title: Window pattern all short except last layer
spec: Set WINDOW_PATTERN = "SSSSSSSL" for depth 8 so only the final layer uses full context and the other layers use the half-context window. The code should already always make the last layer full. This should speed up each step, so more tokens fit into 300 s.

title: Short-window-only attention with 256 window
spec: Change WINDOW_PATTERN to 'SSSL' with the short window reduced from half the context (1024) to 256 tokens, with the last layer still full. This makes attention cheaper, giving more steps in the fixed time.

title: Head dim 64 (more heads)
spec: Set HEAD_DIM = 64 so the depth-8 model (dim 512) has 8 heads instead of 4. Keep everything else the same, including the value embeddings and window pattern. Make sure the number of KV heads follows the number of heads.

title: Batch 2**18 plus warmup 0.03 combined

title: Gradient clipping 1.0
spec: Add torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(model.parameters(), 1.0) before the optimizer step to stabilise training with higher LRs.

title: Warmdown ratio 0.7

title: Embedding LR 0.4 and unembedding LR 0.008

title: Shorter warmdown 0.3
spec: Set WARMDOWN_RATIO = 0.3 so more time is spent at peak LR.

title: Depth 6

title: Batch 2**18 with warmdown 0.3

title: Short warmup 0.02
spec: Set WARMUP_RATIO = 0.02 to smooth the early Muon/Adam steps.

title: Gradient clipping at 1.0
spec: Before optimizer.step, call torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(model.parameters(), 1.0) after the backward passes of all micro-batches. Do not change anything else. Stabilizes the high-LR Adam embedding/scalar updates.

title: Matrix LR 0.06 with Muon momentum 0.97
spec: Raise MATRIX_LR from 0.04 to 0.06 and make the Muon momentum ramp end at 0.97 instead of its current final value (0.95). Bolder optimizer change targeting faster convergence in the short budget.

title: Untie nothing: zero-init residual projections and smaller init
spec: Initialize the attention output projection (c_proj) and MLP output projection weights to zeros (if not already) and scale the embedding init std down by half (e.g. 0.5 instead of 1.0). Tests whether better init speeds early training.

title: Adam betas (0.9, 0.99) and short warmup

title: Scalar LR 0.25 and lm_head LR 0.008
spec: Combine two earlier small gains on top of the current incumbent: set SCALAR_LR to 0.25 and UNEMBEDDING_LR to 0.008. Change nothing else.

title: Depth 10 with narrower aspect ratio 48

title: Lower total batch size to 2**18

title: Total batch 2**17

title: ReLU^2 to SwiGLU-ish check

title: Depth 4 wider

title: Sequence-length packing: shorter context 1024 with larger device batch

title: Depth 5 model

title: Untied-init small embedding std plus lower embedding LR

title: Head dim 64 (6 heads)

title: Short warmup 0.02

title: Depth 6 wider

title: Lower total batch to 2**18
spec: Set TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE = 2**18 (keep DEVICE_BATCH_SIZE 64, so grad accumulation halves). In a fixed 300 s budget, more optimizer steps usually help a small model.

title: Muon momentum warmup shorter

title: Depth 6 at aspect 64
spec: Set DEPTH = 6 to trade capacity for more training steps in the fixed time budget.

title: Gradient clipping
spec: Add torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(model.parameters(), 1.0) before the optimizer step. Keep it simple, with no extra logging.

title: Batch 2**20 tokens per step
spec: Set TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE to 2**20 so grad accumulation doubles. Fewer, larger steps may help the final loss at this model size. Keep DEVICE_BATCH_SIZE 64 and scale MATRIX_LR by 1.2 to compensate.

spec: Set DEPTH=5 and ASPECT_RATIO=102 so model_dim is about 512 (rounded to a HEAD_DIM multiple). This tests a shallower model that gets more steps in 300 s. Keep the other hyperparameters unchanged.

title: Wider MLP 5x with depth 5
spec: Set DEPTH=5 and ASPECT_RATIO=102 (512-dim). Change the MLP hidden dim from 4*n_embd to 5*n_embd (c_fc out features and c_proj in features). Parameters are roughly matched to the depth-6 incumbent, and the model has fewer sequential layers and so is faster per step.

title: Weight decay 0.1 for Muon
spec: Set WEIGHT_DECAY from 0.2 to 0.1. With a short 300 s run the model is data-limited rather than overfit, so less decay may help. Change nothing else.

title: Matrix LR 0.06 with Muon WD decay
spec: Set MATRIX_LR to 0.06 and make the Muon weight decay shrink linearly to 0 over training, scaled by the same progress factor as the LR schedule. This tests a bolder LR jump together with a fading regularizer.

title: Scalar LR 0.25
spec: Halve SCALAR_LR from 0.5 to 0.25.

title: Total batch size increased
spec: Change TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE from 2**19 to 2**20 (exactly double the current 524k token target), assuming the GPU headroom allows it.

title: Optimal scheduler
spec: Change optimizer.SCHEDULE to 'cosine' for smoother and more stable training.

title: Better warmup
spec: Set WARMUP_FRAC from 0.0 to 0.01 to add a small warmup period, improving stability of the first steps.

title: Optimization budget doubled
spec: Change OPTIMIZATION_BUDGET fraction from .5 to 1.0, ensuring all steps are optimized unless per-slot budget rules.

title: Optimize weight decay
spec: Increase WEIGHT_DECAY to 0.4 to add stronger regularization and model stability.

title: Layer-wise Learning Rate Adjustment
spec: Modify the optimizer loop to scale the learning rate for each layer's gradient by the layer's parameter count or a lightweight feature norm before applying Adam, smoothing the gradient landscape.

title: More warmup
spec: Increase WARMUP_RATIO to 0.1 to further improve gradient stability at the start of training.

title: Denoising Diffusion Prior
spec: Add a small MLP that predicts noise from the residual stream and adds Gaussian noise to the pre-attention or pre-feedforward inputs, acting as a regularizer.

title: Fewer heads
spec: Reduce HEAD_DIM to 96 to reduce computational complexity and allow for a larger batch size.

title: Convolutional Substrate
spec: Introduce a 3D convolutional sublayer in parallel to the attention heads to capture local spatial patterns, acting as a stronger feature extractor.

title: Less decay
spec: Reduce WEIGHT_DECAY to 0.05 to allow more flexibility in early training steps.

title: Optimal architecture
spec: Reduce ASPECT_RATIO to 32 to make the model more efficient with fewer attention heads.

title: Grad Norm Clipping per Layer
spec: Apply gradient clipping not to the global norm, but to each individual layer's gradient norm independently, preventing any single layer from dominating the update.

title: More heads
spec: Increase HEAD_DIM to 192 to allow for more attention heads, potentially improving model capacity and performance.

title: Layer-Specific Learning Rate Decay
spec: Instead of a global linear warmdown, apply a cosine decay schedule specifically to the transformer layers (depth) while keeping embeddings static, using WARM_RATIO and WARMUP_RATIO control to shape the decay curve over the remaining 50% of the budget.

title: Recent Update Warmup
spec: Switch WARMUP_RATIO from 0.0 to a low positive value like 0.008, adding a very short, high-impact warmup phase before the steep cosine decay to stabilize initial gradient updates.

title: Gradient Saturation with Residual Dropout
spec: Apply a small amount of residual dropout (e.g., 0.01) after each transformer block's output but before the residual connection, saturating gradients and forcing the model to learn more robust representations.

title: Lower learning rate
spec: Reduce MATRIX_LR to 0.02 to stabilize the model during fine-tuning of the matrix parameters.

title: Batch size reduced
spec: Lower DATA_OPTIMIZER_BATCH_SIZE by 50% to reduce per-step gradient variance and improve stability.

title: Layer-wise Learning Rate Heating
spec: Apply a progressive increase to the learning rate for deeper layers (higher index) by a factor of 1.05x over the first 10% of training, compensating for their tendency to learn slower.

title: Long Warming Up Period
spec: Wrap WARMUP_RATIO = 0.0 in a new block setting warmup_steps fraction to 0.1 while keeping warmdown proportion unchanged to allow more stable convergence on small GPT before decay.

title: Hybrid Scheduler
spec: Replace current warmup schedule with a hybrid scheduling strategy that applies cosine annealing for better convergence.

title: GELU Integration
spec: Replace ReLU activation with GELU for better performance in small networks that can reduce overestimation.

title: Adam W Warmup
spec: Change beta2 adaptation to warmup-based schedule in Adam optimizer to stabilize training and reduce variance in small networks.

title: Mixed Precision Boost
spec: Add mixed precision training support by specifying torch amp settings in the training loop with AMP_STEPS calculation to allow higher batch sizes without overflow.

title: Amygdala Optimization
spec: Modify optimizer parameters to include additional regularization terms for better convergence.

title: FOCUS Attention
spec: Replace standard attention with FOCUS attention mechanism to improve attention distribution and reduce noise.

title: Hydra Scheduler
spec: Modify scheduler parameters to include additional regularization terms to improve convergence.

title: EMA Queue
spec: Maintain an exponential moving average of model parameters for better generalization by reducing noise in the final predictions.

title: AdamW Eta
spec: Change AdamW eta parameter to reduce noise in gradient updates for smoother convergence.

title: बाउंडअर Embedding
spec: Replace standard embeddings with bounded embedding technique to improve accuracy and reduce overestimation.

title: Gradient Cross-Entropy Penalty
spec: Add a penalty term to the loss function that penalizes high gradient cross-entropy between consecutive layer outputs, encouraging smoother feature transitions.

title: AdamW Epsilon
spec: Change AdamW epsilon from small value to larger value for smoother convergence.

title: Sparse Attention
spec: Replace full attention with sparse attention mechanism to reduce computation overhead and improve training stability on long contexts.

title: Window-Expansion
spec: Replace the 'SSSL' window pattern with 'SSSSL' or 'L' (full context) windows, allowing the model to process a larger receptive field per step and thus have a more expressive evaluation capability.

title: Data-Blend Injection
spec: In the training loop, before processing the full batch, inject a small amount of random 'noise' tokens (dummy vocab) into the input stream. This扰s the data slightly and forces the model to become more robust.

title: Embedding-Decay Rate
spec: Lower UNEMBEDDING_LR from 0.004 to 0.0001, making its updates so slow that it barely affects the loss for most of the 300s window, allowing matrix weights to dominate the optimization.

title: Layer-Sequence Decay
spec: Replace the WARMUP_RATIO of 0.0 with a small positive value (e.g., 0.1) and change WARMDOWN_RATIO from 0.5 to 0.0, and introduce a custom schedule where LR creeps down very slowly, then drops sharply near the end, keeping early training very stable.

title: Dynamic-Window Size
spec: Replace the static WINDOW_PATTERN with a dynamic pattern that adjusts based on the current position in the data sequence. Compute a variable window size per token.

title: Zeroed-Increment Update
spec: Only add a tiny epsilon term to the weight update rule to increment weights by a constant factor (even if that factor is 0.0001), ensuring that even as the Adam terms decayed out, there is a baseline push.

title: Sparse Token Replacement
spec: Replace only 0.5% of tokens in the training loop with random tokens instead of 2%, reducing the noise impact while still providing a semblance of regularization.

title: Mixed-Precision AdamW
spec: Switch to mixed precision (BF16/FP32) for optimizer states in AdamW to reduce memory fragmentation and allow slightly larger effective batches or faster convergence.

title: Embed-Only Warmup
spec: Apply warmup to embedding and lm_head only, while keeping matrix parameters at full learned rate from the start. This prioritizes early embedding alignment.

title: Positional-Sparse Update
spec: Modify the output layer (lm_head) to perform a partial gradient update where updates are only applied to positions with an even index, then swap focus to odd indices in subsequent steps.

title: Semi-Frozen Layers
spec: For every other layer, set their recurrence weight to zero (or a small epsilon) for parts of the loop, effectively freezing them and only updating every second layer.

title: Round-Step Update
spec: Round the global step number at each optimizer step, ensuring that every N steps updates occur with the same multiplier. This forces progress to occur in discrete 'waves' rather than continuous flow.

title: AdamG Trend Peak (Optimizer)
spec: Set WARMUP_RATIO = 0.3 and DANSE (direct, adaptive, non-standard schedule and early stopping) to 0.0 to apply a steeper initial learning rate boost.

title: Gradient-Clip Magnitude (Optimizer)
spec: Lower the gradient clipping norm from default (usually 1.0) to 0.1 to dampen large updates and reduce variance in later layers.

title: Gradient-Cum-Sum
spec: Instead of applying the standard Adam update, accumulate the gradient sum over a window of steps (e.g., 10 steps) and apply a single averaged update at the end of that window.

title: Batch-Fragmentation (Batch)
spec: Run with DEVICE_BATCH_SIZE = 4 to split the optimizer step into 16 smaller chunks per physical step, potentially bypassing KV cache bottlenecks at high sequence lengths.

title: Embedding-L2-Fix (Data)
spec: Remove the L2 normalization of embeddings at the start of training by commenting out that line, allowing embeddings to grow in magnitude with the data distribution.

title: LR-Spike Warmup
spec: Start with a very high initial LR (e.g., 0.05 for MATRIX_LR) that decays linearly, then warm down aggressively over the remaining time. This lets the model learn fast features early.

title: Cache-Update Strategy
spec: Use a smaller cache size (or lower-depth cache) by reducing the days that you keep, potentially forcing the model to recompute certain operations more often.

title: Learning Rate Schedulers
spec: Replace the linear warmup with a cosine warmup followed by a cosine decay, potentially improving convergence.

title: Gradient Accumulation
spec: Increase the number of gradient accumulation steps to effectively simulate a larger per-step batch size, allowing the model to learn from more data per update.

title: Gradient Checkpointing
spec: Enable gradient checkpointing (re-computation) during the forward pass to reduce memory usage by half, allowing for larger effective batch sizes or faster training without VRAM constraints.

title: Gradient Clip Coverage
spec: Apply gradient clipping with a norm-based scaling factor that adapts to the current batch's gradient magnitude, improving stability.

title: Cross-Entropy Smoothing
spec: Apply cross-entropy smoothing to the target distribution during training, which reduces overfitting on rare tokens.

title: Three-Phase Learning Rate Scheduler
spec: Replace the current linear warmup and cosine decay schedule with a three-phase schedule: linear warmup for 10% of the budget, constant high LR for 40%, then cosine decay for 50%. This extension reduces the dead zone in training and improves generalization on short training sequences.

title: Layer-wise AFED
spec: Apply layer-wise adaptive filter for dense vectors (init), potentially improving initialization of deep layers.

title: Batch Level Bias
spec: Add batch-level bias terms to the attention mechanism, improving the model's ability to adapt to different data batches.

title: Spatial Attention
spec: Substitute standard self-attention with spatial attention mechanisms that process sequences spatially, potentially capturing local dependencies better.

title: Dynamic Window Mask
spec: Replace the fixed sliding window pattern with a dynamic window mask that is determined by the maximum gradient magnitude in the current batch, expanding the context window to 2x if the gradient magnitude is large and shrinking it otherwise.

title: Curriculum Multi-cale Stochastic Depth
spec: Introduce a stochastic hiddle layer dropout schedule that increases the fraction of dropped layers as training progresses, focusing on higher layers first to allow early layers to specialize and then gradually destabilize deeper representations.

title: Batch-Specific Gradient Weighting
spec: Apply a batch-specific gradient weighting method that applies a different weighting function to gradients based on the batch's global norm, allowing higher-noise batches to receive more conservative updates.

title: Masked FFN
spec: Apply a masked feed-forward network with a quadratic activation function, which is more expressive and requires less data.

title: Scheduled Dropout
spec: Replace standard L2Norm with L2Norm plus alpha (a variant that adds alpha to the L2Norm), improving generalization.

title: Schedule with Gradient-Sensitive Warmdown
spec: Replace the fixed warmdown schedule with a gradient-sensitive warmdown schedule that adjusts the learning rate based on the current gradient magnitude, allowing the model to warmdown faster when gradients are small and slow when gradients are large.

title: Count-Skip Batch Size
spec: Reduce DEVICE_BATCH_SIZE from 64 to 16 and increase TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE via gradient accumulation to 32, to ensure more optimizer steps per batch and stronger regularization, while keeping the total tokens per second constant.

title: Micro-Step Learning Rate Decay
spec: Instead of decaying LR globally at the end of the epoch, apply an exponential decay to the LR multiplier every N micro-steps (e.g., 10 steps) during the warmdown phase, smoothing the effective learning rate curve.

title: Linear Warmup with Cosine
spec: Modify the schedule to use linear warmup then cosine annealing instead of straight decay.

title: Gradual Weight Decay
spec: Reduce WEIGHT_DECAY from 0.2 to 0.05 to decrease regularization strength, allowing the model to learn more complex representations early on.

title: Warmup LR Schedule
spec: Change WARMUP_RATIO from 0.0 to 0.05 to introduce a linear warmup ramping learning rate over 5% of the training step, preventing initial large gradients that may destabilize early training.

title: Beta1 Increase
spec: Increase ADAM_BETAS alpha1 to 0.99 for more smoothing of momentum.

title: Scaling LR by Batch
spec: Scale learning rate inversely with batch size to maintain optimal magnitude.

title: Adam Decay
spec: Change beta2 to 0.999 for more stable updates.

title: Embedding Learning Rate
spec: Increase EMBEDDING_LR from 0.6 to 1.0 to help token embeddings converge faster and potentially reach better minima.

title: Layer Depth Increase
spec: Increase DEPTH from 8 to 12 layers. Deeper models may capture more complex features if training is stable.

title: Final LR Scaling
spec: Set FINAL_LR_FRAC to 0.2 to maintain a non-zero final learning rate for continued refinement.

title: Gradient Accumulation Increase
spec: Increase TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE to 2**15 (32768) by reducing gradient accumulation steps or improving optimizer stability, allowing smaller per-step updates that may generalize better.

title: Warmup Ratio Decrease
spec: Reduce WARMUP_RATIO to 0.02 for a shorter, sharper warmup.

title: Layerwise Optimize
spec: Use layerwise adaptation to optimize different layers with different rates.

title: Increase Window Size
spec: Change WINDOW_PATTERN to LLVM to allow larger context windows if not restricted by current batch size.

title: Fixed Learning Rate Fine-Tuning
spec: Switch from warmup to a constant or slight decay LR schedule by setting WARMUP_RATIO=0.0 and adding a small decay step, smoothing optimization trajectory.

title: Embedding Homoarchy
spec: Increase EMBEDDING_LR again (revisit), specifically for embedding layers to reduce collision.

title: Add Adam Update Frequency Adjustment
spec: Increase Adam update frequency (balance gradient accumulation and batch size ratio) to reduce noise and allow smaller effective steps per iteration, smoothing convergence and potentially reducing val_bpb.

title: Use a Smoother LR Schedule (Cosine with Restart)
spec: Modify learning rate schedule to include periodic restarts after certain epochs, effectively resetting the training state to avoid premature convergence and exploring broader solution space.

title: Reduce initialization scale
spec: Modify the initialization scale of weights to be smaller (e.g., 0.02 instead of 0.05), requiring more learning steps but potentially yielding better final solutions.

title: Balance head and depth
spec: Change ASPECT_RATIO to 32 and HEAD_DIM to 16 to adjust the balance between depth and width, potentially improving trainability.

title: Unembed learning rate reduction
spec: If applicable, reduce UNEMBEDDING_LR from 0.004 to 0.001 to reduce updates to the head parameters, which are often harder to tune than feedforward weights.

title: Increase matrix learning rate
spec: Change MATRIX_LR from 0.04 to 0.08 to accelerate updates to the main matrix parameters, hoping to reach low loss faster and escape local minima sooner.

title: Reduce warmup fraction
spec: Change WARMUP_RATIO from 0.0 to 0.05 (or small positive value) to avoid potential initial learning rate spikes that might destabilize early training steps, allowing earlier initialization of the optimizer schedule.

title: Combine batch size and window
spec: Try DEVICE_BATCH_SIZE = 16 with a larger window pattern if possible, to balance between memory constraints and context modeling capabilities.

title: Increase Warmdown Ratio from 0.5 to 0.7
spec: Increase the warmdown fraction to decay the learning rate earlier in the training run, which may help the model reach a lower error more quickly.

title: Gradient Accumulation with Larger Step Size
spec: Increase TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE by 2x and reduce optimizer step frequency via gradient accumulation to lower per-iteration noise and potentially stabilize training with a no-change budget step.

title: Decline Learning Rate (Warmup + Decay)
spec: Enable linear warmup from 0.0 to WARMUP_RATIO and apply cosine warmup with decay to smooth the learning rate trajectory and prevent large initial spikes.

title: Reduce weight decay
spec: Change WEIGHT_DECAY from 0.2 to 0.05 to allow smaller parameter norms during early training, potentially improving收敛 in large models like ModelOptim.

title: Increase aspect ratio
spec: Change ASPECT_RATIO from 64 to 96 to increase model depth while keeping total parameters roughly similar to current depth-head product, potentially accessing better solution spaces.

title: Increase MATRIX_LR to 0.06
spec: Set MATRIX_LR from 0.04 to 0.06 to enhance convergence speed.

title: Weight Decay on MLP-only Layers
spec: Apply weight decay only to MLP layers in Muon, excluding attention and residual connections, to reduce regularization of the main parameter bottleneck.

title: Reduce weight decay to 0.08
spec: Set WEIGHT_DECAY from 0.2 to 0.08 to reduce regularization and allow faster learning.

title: Modify activation function
spec: Replace GELU with GLU or SwiGLU if supported, which can improve model expressiveness and efficiency.

title: Change warmup schedule
spec: Instead of linear warmup from 0 to final lr, try cosine or sqrt warmup which can be more stable for large models.

title: Enable Weight Decay on Projection Layers Only
spec: Apply weight decay only to the projection layers (MMT, MI, MO) within the transformer, zeroing out weight decay for other parameters, to reduce the regularization effect on non-projection parameters and allow for a more focused optimization on the key components.

title: Increase final LR fraction
spec: Change FINAL_LR_FRAC from 0.0 to 0.001 to allow a slight learning rate boost at the end of training, potentially helping escape a flat plateau.

title: Enable Gradient Checkpointing for Global Micro-batch Efficiency
spec: Replace standard forward/backward with a gradient checkpointing mechanism within the training loop by introducing a block that marks peak computation in the transformer and unrolling the forward pass with a save_torch checkpoint hook, reducing memory requirements to enable larger device batch sizes without re-allocating gradient histories.

title: Learning Rate Decay Step
spec: Trigger LR decay once every 3 epochs to periodically reduce learning rate and improve convergence.

title: Gradient Clipping
spec: Add gradient clipping at norm=1.0 to prevent unstable updates and improve convergence.

title: Linear Warmup Schedule
spec: Set WARMUP_RATIO = 0.1 and add a linear warmup schedule over the first 10% of training time to stabilize gradient growth.

title: Gradient Accumulation
spec: Increase optimizer steps per batch accumulation to 2, effectively doubling the batch size without OOM.

title: Layerwise Learning Rate
spec: Replace fixed matrix learning rate with layerwise adjustments, scaling hidden state norms each epoch to balance training signal.

title: Gradient Resolution Reconstruction
spec: Modify gradient reconstruction to use sparse resolution to improve stability with small gradients.

title: Learning Rate Scheduler
spec: Implement step decay with 5 epochs of cooldown to reduce learning rate gradually.

title: Weight Tying
spec: Tie embedding and projection weights to reduce model size and improve generalization on smaller contexts.

title: Learning Rate Scaling
spec: Scale learning rate by 1/sqrt(batch size) to stabilize training across different batch sizes.

title: Learning Rate Decay
spec: Implement cosine annealing LR decay with warm restarts to periodically reset the schedule.

title: Sparse MoE
spec: Implement Sparse MoE block to expand model capacity while keeping parameters efficient.

title: Redundant Interaction Layer
spec: Insert an extra transformer layer at the beginning of the forward pass (zero-initialized, standard shift-around) that simply passes data through (Identity or standard) to the first real layer. While usually detrimental, training this layer more aggressively is essentially a case of strategy. If the performance degrades, it can be removed. If it helps, it is added as a permanent change. The primary goal here is to figure out if a larger effective model size (via layers) improves val_bpb.

title: Reduced Batch Size
spec: Reduce DEVICE_BATCH_SIZE to 32 to lower per-layer gradients and allow for higher learning rates.

title: Dynamic Learning Rate
spec: Use a learning rate that decreases only when performance metric shows improvement.

title: Cosine Annealing with Restart
spec: Replace current step/Sigmoid warmdown with a 5-stage cosine annealing schedule using 7.5% budget. After each stage finishes, restart warmup to 0.1 and let LR climb back to max. This introduces curvature that often outperforms static shapes for small GPTs.

title: Local Response Normalization
spec: Add a simple local response normalization layer to stabilize activations during training.

title: Sparse Attention
spec: Reduce attention scope to 16% of keys and values with per-layer routers.

title: LR Scheduler Family Addition
spec: Switch to CosineLR with restarts or a similar more aggressive scheduler if standard LinearSchedule is used.

title: Unembedding Learning Rate Decrease
spec: UNEMBEDDING_LR = 0.002

title: Matrix Learning Rate Adjustment
spec: MATRIX_LR = 0.02

title: Depth Increase
spec: DEPTH = 16

title: Reduced Weight Decay
spec: WEIGHT_DECAY = 0.01

title: Increase Total Batch Size to 2^20
spec: Increase the total batch size from 2**19 (~524K tokens) to 2**20 (~1M tokens). Assuming 300s is fixed, this increases the effective step size, allowing for a more stable gradient estimate and possibly reducing optimizer steps needed for a complete training cycle.

title: Increase Warmup Ratio to 0.05
spec: Increase the warmup ratio from 0.0 to 0.05, introducing a small gradual ramp-up of the learning rate before decline. This can stabilize early training and reduce the risk of divergence in the first few stages.

title: Implement Gradient Checkpointing
spec: Replace standard forward/backward passes with gradient checkpointing (`torch.enable_gradซึ่ง ... torch.disable_grad`). This trades 2x memory for storage of activations during backward pass, allowing potentially larger effective batch sizes or deeper models on 40GB A100.

title: Boost Embedding and Unembedding Learning Rates Simultaneously
spec: Increase both the embedding learning rate from 0.6 to 1.0 and the unembedding learning rate from 0.004 to 0.008. This strengthens the token vocabulary representation and the projection head simultaneously, potentially improving loss rate.

title: Increase Head Dimension to 144
spec: Increase the head dimension from 128 to 144. A slightly wider attention dimension often improves representational capacity for native head dimensions (near square roots of prime numbers like 144=12*12), at roughly the same cost to memory per layer.

title: Optimize Adam Betas
spec: Change ADAM_BETAS from (0.8, 0.95) to (0.9, 0.95) to better absorb high-frequency gradients and reduce noise in early training.

title: Increase Matrix Learning Rate
spec: Increase MATRIX_LR from 0.04 to 0.08 to accelerate convergence on matrix parameters during the early training phase.

title: Expand Warmdown Phase
spec: Replace WARMDOWN_RATIO from 0.5 to 0.8 to extend the learning rate tail, allowing better convergence at lower final learning rates.

title: Increase Head Dimension (Linear)
spec: Increase HEAD_DIM from 128 to 192 while keeping ASPECT_RATIO at 64 to expand attention capacity without increasing depth significantly.

title: Increase Scalar Learning Rate (Muon)
spec: Increase SCALAR_LR from 0.5 to 1.0 to boost updates to per-layer float16 scalars, potentially improving token ambiguity handling.

title: Increase Warmup Ratio
spec: Increase WARMUP_RATIO from 0.0 to 0.1 to smooth gradient updates early in training and reduce batch variance effects.

title: Gradient Accumulation
spec: If existing, ensure gradient accumulation steps are optimized. If not, add gradient accumulation logic carefully.

title: Increase Window Pattern Sparsity (SSSS)
spec: Change the sliding window pattern from 'SSSL' (window size 3) to 'SSSS' (window size 4). This increases the attention context window from 8 to 16 tokens, capturing longer-range dependencies without changing model width.

title: Gradient Accumulation Steps
spec: Increase the number of gradient accumulation steps to train a larger virtual batch size without exceeding memory limits.

title: Weight Decay
spec: Increase the WEIGHT_DECAY parameter to a larger value to reduce the magnitude of the weights and thus reduce overfitting.

title: Linear Scaling LR Rule
spec: Use the linear scaling rule to adjust the learning rate based on the batch size, potentially allowing for faster convergence.

title: Unembedding LR
spec: Decrease the UNEMBEDDING_LR parameter to a smaller value to reduce the gradient step size for lm_head layers.

title: LR Warmdown
spec: Add a simple warmdown schedule after the warmup period to help the model converge to the optimal solution.

title: LR Warmup
spec: Add a simple linear warmup schedule at the beginning of training to help the model avoid difficult losses at the start.

title: Polynomial LR Schedule
spec: Replace the constant WARMUP_RATIO and WARMDOWN_RATIO with a polynomial decay schedule that tapers learning rate more smoothly over the training time.

title: LR Step
spec: Add a step schedule that decreases the learning rate at specific steps to improve the long-term convergence of the model.

title: Batch Size Scaling
spec: Scale the learning rate and other hyperparameters based on the batch size to ensure consistent convergence.

title: LR Decay
spec: Add a decay schedule that decreases the learning rate over time to improve the long-term convergence of the model.

title: Aspect Ratio Adjustment
spec: Increase the ASPECT_RATIO parameter to a larger value to go deeper with fewer parameters per layer.

title: Hybrid Attention Mechanism
spec: Replace standard attention with a Cortex-style attention mechanism in the transformer module, switching between sparse and dense attention.

title: Embedding LR
spec: Decrease the EMBEDDING_LR parameter to a smaller value to reduce the gradient step size for token embeddings.

title: Variable Batch Size Strategy
spec: Discretize the batch size by varying it across iterations to avoid the need for gradient accumulation.

title: Parameter Grouping
spec: Split the momentum parameters into separate groups inside Adam that are updated at different rates to optimize the training landscape.

title: Head Dimension Increase
spec: Increase the HEAD_DIM parameter to a larger value while keeping the total number of parameters constant.

title: Model Size Reduction
spec: Reduce the DEPTH parameter to a smaller value while maintaining the same number of parameters through increased head dimensions.

title: Corrupted Gradient Masking
spec: Randomly mask out 0.5% of tokens' gradients during every batch update to reduce the model's susceptibility to model-specific, non-generalizable errors.
