spec: Decrease the MATRIX_LR parameter to a smaller value to reduce the gradient step size for matrix parameters.

title: Reduce final learning rate fraction
spec: Change FINAL_LR_FRAC from 0.0 to 0.2. Allowing a small residual learning rate at the end can help refine weights further rather than stopping exactly at the warmup down phase.

title: Reduce warmup ratio to accelerate learning
spec: Change WARMUP_RATIO from 0.0 to 0.1. Adding a small warmup period allows the model to reach peak learning rate sooner, potentially finding better minima and lowering val_bpb.

title: Increase matrix learning rate
spec: Change MATRIX_LR from 0.04 to 0.2. Higher learning rate for matrix parameters can accelerate convergence to a lower val_bpb minimum.

title: Reduce weight decay to strengthen learning
spec: Change WEIGHT_DECAY from 0.2 to 0.01. Lower regularization allows parameters to update more aggressively, potentially achieving lower val_bpb if overfitting is not an issue.

title: Increase warmdown ratio
spec: Change WARMDOWN_RATIO from 0.5 to 0.8. A longer warmdown period can smoothly decay the learning rate, avoiding sharp drops in parameter updates and allowing better convergence.

title: Increase total batch size significantly
spec: Change TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE from 2**19 (~524K) to 2**20 (~1M). Larger batches per step can stabilize the loss landscape, potentially lowering val_bpb through better averaging of gradients.

title: Switch to AdamW with decoupled weight decay for better regularization
spec: Change the optimizer to use decoupled weight decay by setting a custom logic where weight decay applies only to model weights, not bias terms, to improve convergence.

title: Increase weight decay to regularize training more aggressively and stabilize early learning
spec: Raise WEIGHT_DECAY from 0.2 to 0.5 to reduce overfitting and potentially stabilize early training dynamics, which may lead to better validation performance on small models.

title: Increase warmup ratio to flatten the loss landscape at the start
spec: Set WARMUP_RATIO to 0.2 (increasing from 0.0) to ensure a longer escape from saddle points at the initialization, which might help the optimizer find better minima in this specific task.

title: Increase scalar learning rate to speed up training of per-layer scalars
spec: Raise SCALAR_LR from 0.5 to 1.0 to accelerate the learning of per-layer scalars, potentially leading to faster convergence on the validation set.

title: Reduce Warmdown Ratio to 0.2 to Allow Faster Initial Learning
spec: Set `WARMDOWN_RATIO = 0.2`. This shortens the LR decay phase, allowing the model to continue learning aggressively for a larger portion of the 300s budget, which could reduce overfitting and val_bpb.

title: Increase Matrix Learning Rate to 0.08
spec: Set `MATRIX_LR = 0.08`. This increases the learning rate for the core matrix parameters, allowing faster convergence of the main model weights.

title: Reduce aspect ratio to increase width
spec: Change ASPECT_RATIO from 64 to 32. This increases the width of the transformer at the cost of fewer layers, potentially a better balance for task performance and lowering val_bpb.

title: Reduce Depth to Minimize Effective Parameters per Layer and Improve Stability
spec: Change `DEPTH` from 8 to 4. A deeper model may suffer from sub-optimal optimization at this small epoch budget; reducing depth forces the optimizer to focus on fewer parameters per layer, potentially improving convergence and reducing val_bpb, especially if the current loss surface is noisy.

title: Lower Weight Decay to 0.01 and Increase SCALAR_LR to 2.0
spec: Set `WEIGHT_DECAY = 0.01` and `SCALAR_LR = 2.0`. This combination reduces regularization on the global parameters while aggressively updating per-layer scalars, which may lead to a better fit with fewer validation bits per byte.

title: Increase learning rate for embeddings
spec: Change EMBEDDING_LR from 0.6 to 3.0. Higher embedding learning rate can adapt input representations faster, potentially improving model fit and reducing val_bpb.

title: Increase depth to capture more context
spec: Change DEPTH from 8 to 12. Deeper models can represent more complex functions, potentially leading to a lower val_bpb on the task if the model was previously too shallow.

title: Try exponential differential LR schedule instead of linear warmup+warmdown
spec: Replace the linear warmup/warmdown schedule with an exponential decay schedule that starts high, drops rapidly, and stabilizes at a non-zero floor to allow faster initial optimization while maintaining stable gradients.

title: Depth Increase
spec: Increase DEPTH from 8 to 12 to deeper models, which may capture better representations and lower val_bpb if the extra capacity justifies the extra budget.

title: Gradual Warming
spec: Replace WARMUP_RATIO=0.0 with WARMUP_RATIO=0.1 to introduce a linear warmup phase, allowing gradients to build and advisor to stabilize before full training pressure.

title: Embedding LR Reduction
spec: Reduce EMBEDDING_LR from 0.6 to 0.3, acknowledging that embedding updates are often stable and aggressive learning rates can cause instability.

title: Learning Rate Scheduler Type Change
spec: Change from a constant LR schedule to a cosine decay schedule to dynamically adjust learning rate based on training progress.

title: Gradient Accumulation Increase
spec: Increase the effective gradient accumulation steps if machine allows, to simulate larger batches and improve gradient stability.

title: Activation Function Change
spec: Consider switching from ReLU to GELU or SwiGLU to improve the quality of non-linear activations in the transformer layers.

title: Weight Decay Reduction
spec: Reduce WEIGHT_DECAY=0.2 to WEIGHT_DECAY=0.05 to lower regularization, potentially allowing gradients to converge faster and reducing overfitting in early stages.

title: Scalar Learning Rate Increase
spec: Increase SCALAR_LR from 0.5 to 1.0 to aggressively update layer-wise scaling factors, which are often helpful for adaptive learning rates.

title: Matrix LR Increase
spec: Increase MATRIX_LR from 0.04 to 0.08 to accelerate learning of core transformer parameters which dominate the loss landscape.

title: Positive Laplacian scaling
spec: Turn on Laplacian regularization benefits, which can smooth losses and reduce noise in gradient updates, especially in later stages of training, which can help in data-scars situations.

title: Increase Adam Beta2
spec: Set ADAM_BETAS = (0.9, 0.9999) to provide more aggressive momentum smoothing for long-range dependencies. Family: optimizer.

title: Increase Adam Beta1
spec: Set ADAM_BETAS = (0.9, 0.95) to damp high-frequency noise in gradient updates. Family: optimizer.

title: Increase Weight Decay for Regularization
spec: Set WEIGHT_DECAY = 0.3 to strengthen regularization on weight parameters, potentially reducing overfitting and lower variance in val_bpb. Family: regularization.

title: Change Time Budget (Schedule)
spec: Increase WARMDOWN_RATIO or adjust the timeline to emphasize later gradient steps if current early warmdown is too aggressive. Family: schedule.

title: Adam Beta2 Increase
spec: Increase ADAM_BETAS[1] from 0.95 to 0.99 to slow down the decay of momentum, smoothly adapting the learning rate over time.

title: Try Unembedding LR Increase
spec: Increase UNEMBEDDING_LR from 0.004 to 0.006 to update the linear head faster, potentially aligning predictions sooner. Family: optimizer.

title: Safety Warmup Schedule
spec: Add a safety cooldown phase in the warmup schedule where learning rates are lower and do not increase, allowing the optimizer to take a few small steps before ramping up, which helps finding better local minima.

title: Increase Loss Weight Adjustment (Sample Loss)
spec: Modify the loss function to weight certain samples higher or lower based on their length or position, possibly reducing noise from padding or short sequences. Family: data.

title: Loss Normalization
spec: Normalize losses and gradients more aggressively, which can speed up convergence and stabilize training by scaling the loss and gradient correctly at each step.

title: Learning Rate Decay
spec: Apply exponential LR decay over time (e.g., 0.9^t) to reduce learning rate as training progresses.

title: Cosine Decay
spec: Use cosine annealing for the learning rate decay schedule to reduce learning rate gradually.

title: Gradient Checkpointing
spec: Add gradient checkpointing to reduce memory usage, allowing larger batch sizes or enabling OFT.

title: Cosine-Warmup Scheduler
spec: Replace WARMUP_RATIO = 0.0 with a cosine-warmup scheduler to gradually increase learning rate at the start, potentially stabilizing early convergence.

title: Residual Connections
spec: Add skip connections in the residual block to help flow gradients through the network.

title: Gradient Accumulation
spec: Cumulate gradients for a longer period before the optimizer step to reduce variance.

title: Depth Reduction
spec: Reduce DEPTH from 8 to 6 and ASPECT_RATIO from 64 to 48 to match the same model size but with fewer layers.

title: Gradient Clipping
spec: Set clip_norm = 5.0 to clip gradients to prevent exploding gradients.

title: Layerwise Decay
spec: Use rank-based layerwise learning rate decay (L_where) instead of scalar_lr to give earlier layers larger initial steps.

title: Momentum Decay
spec: Apply l2-norm scaling to the momentum buffers to dampen high-frequency oscillations during training.

title: Weight Decay Increase
spec: Set WEIGHT_DECAY = 1.0 to strongly regularize the weights, reducing overfitting and val_loss.

title: Gradient Accumulation
spec: Divide TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE into smaller chunks per step and accumulate gradients before optimizer step, effectively reducing batch size noise.

title: Base Model Size
spec: Hdr the HEAD_DIM from 128 down to 64 to reduce model overparameterization and correlate val loss.

title: Dense Attention
spec: Replace the windowed attention with dense self-attention to simplify the architecture and potentially improve training.

title: Layerwise Gradient Clipping (LGClamper)
spec: Apply a Layerwise Gradient Clipping (LGClamper) strategy that clips the gradients layer by layer, preserving the magnitude of gradients in stable layers while reducing noise in unstable layers, leading to smoother convergence.

title: Dense Connection Residual Sum
spec: Modify the residual connections to use a simple summation of residual sums (Dense Connection Residual Sum) across all layers rather than just the first and last, which can help preserve information flow and potentially reduce training errors.

title: Per-Layer Momentum Decay
spec: Apply a Per-Layer Momentum Decay strategy where the momentum term is decayed differently for each layer, based on the layer's depth or distance from the input, to stabilize training for deeper layers.

title: Neck Filter Dropout
spec: Apply dropout only to the gating mechanisms and projection layers of each attention block, with a dropout rate of 0.1, while keeping the feedforward paths intact to reduce noise while maintaining expressivity.

title: SwiGLU
spec: Replace GEGLU with SwiGLU to reduce Gaussian distribution memory usage.

title: Convolutional Attention
spec: Use convolutional attention to reduce memory usage in attention layers.

title: Clustered Group Attention
spec: Use clustered group attention to reduce memory usage in attention layers.

title: Low Rank Attention
spec: Modify attention projection to use lower rank dimensions, reducing compute and memory

title: Skip-Connection Add
spec: Insert a residual block before the final pre-norm linear layer that adds the output of the layer to its input (residual connection), before the pre-norm step. This increases the ability of layers to learn complex transformations.

title: Reciprocal Grad Scaling (RGS)
spec: Update the learning rate optimization during training so that the weight of the parameters in the Adam parameter space is the reciprocal of their magnitude in the prior space. This effectively allows the Adam optimizer to step closer to the global optimum by altering its parametrization.

title: Norm Option (NO)
spec: Add an 'Option' field to every normalization layer (e.g., LeftNorm, RightNorm) that applies a learned multiplier to the normed output. This allows the model to learn how much contribution to give to the normed output.

title: Input-Before-Projection (IBP)
spec: Normalize the input data X in each batch, before passing it to the projection matrices, so that each token is centered in the embedding space. This normalization can lead to better attention patterns by ensuring tokens are closer to the mean prior to attention.

title: Time-Dilation Warmup Tradeoff (TDT)
spec: Allocate 10-2000 seconds of the 300s budget to a heavy pre-phase warmup schedule, extending from 0.004 to 0.001 linearly, then quickly ramping up to 0.0004 by the end. This simulates slower, more stable optimization.

title: Layered Adam
spec: Modify the Adam optimizer to update level parameters (first and second moment estimates) at a rate different from model parameters. Specifically, apply a boosted learning rate to the moment estimates themselves, allowing them to track gradients more closely while retaining convergence stability.

title: SwiGLU Activation
spec: Switch from ReLU to SwiGLU activation in FFN layers to improve representation capacity.

title: Warmdown Ratio Decrease
spec: Set WARMDOWN_RATIO = 0.2 to reduce learning rate decay and maintain higher sensitivity later.

title: Learning Rate Rampdown
spec: Replace constant warmdown with a cosine annealing schedule to smoothly reduce LR.

title: Adaptive Learning Rate
spec: Use an adaptive learning rate schedule based on the norm of the gradient to adjust LR dynamically.

title: Reduced Weight Decay
spec: Set WEIGHT_DECAY = 0.01 to reduce regularization pressure and allow faster convergence on simpler structures.

title: Add Dropout After Attention
spec: Introduce a dropout layer immediately after the attention module to prevent early overfitting and force the model to learn more robust representations.

title: Reduce Head Dimension
spec: Set HEAD_DIM = 64 to reduce model capacity and parameter count.

title: Use Cosine Annealing for Learning Rate Schedule
spec: Replace the linear warmdown schedule with a cosine annealing schedule to provide smoother learning rate decay throughout the training process.

title: Adamp smoothing
spec: Replace Adam with Adamp or AdamW to stabilize training dynamics.

title: Gradient Accumulation
spec: Use gradient accumulation to simulate larger effective batch sizes without exceeding VRAM limits.

title: Increase EBSQ on Convolutional Layers
spec: Introduce EBSQ (exponential bias-squared) on linear layers to encourage lower variance in gradients.

title: Boost Warmup Phase Duration
spec: Increase WARMUP_RATIO from 0.0 to 0.1 to better initialize Adam state before aggressive training in the early phase.

title: Increase Batch Size via Gradient Accumulation
spec: Increase TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE to 2**20 (~1M tokens) and introduce a small gradient_accumulation_steps mechanism or auto-adjust loss scaling to fit effectively on 40GB.

title: Use a Fixed Learning Rate for Attention Weights
spec: Fix the learning rate for attention weights to a small constant value, preventing overfitting in the attention heads during training.

title: Stochastic Depth
spec: Add a skip connection with a probability of 0.5 to encourage regularization through depth.

title: Exponential LR Warmup
spec: Replace WARMUP_RATIO = 0.0 with WARMUP_RATIO = 0.1 to introduce a linear warmup scheduled at the start of training.

title: LR Decay
spec: Introduce a cosine decay after 10% of training time to gradually lower learning rate.

title: WARMUP_RATIO Low
spec: Set WARMUP_RATIO = 0.05 and final LR fraction higher to keep LR higher overall.

title: Cosine Annealing Warmup
spec: Replace linear warmdown with a cosine annealing schedule to smooth the transition of learning rates.

title: Gradient Accumulation
spec: Reduce DEVICE_BATCH_SIZE to 16 and adjust TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE to use gradient accumulation for more stable updates.

title: Scalar LR Low
spec: Decrease SCALAR_LR from 0.5 to 0.02 for localized per-layer scalar control.

title: Warmup Long
spec: Set WARMUP_RATIO = 0.2 to extend the warmup phase and stabilize early gradients.

title: Embedding LR Half
spec: Reduce EMBEDDING_LR from 0.6 to 0.3 to reduce noise in embedding updates.

title: Weight Decay Scaling
spec: Increase WEIGHT_DECAY from 0.2 to 0.5 to strengthen regularization on kernel parameters in the Muon architecture.

title: Residual Squeeze
spec: Reduce ASPECT_RATIO from 64 to 48 to lower the feature channel count while maintaining depth.

title: unembedding_lr_tiny
spec: Reduce the learning rate for the unembedding layer (lm_head) to a tiny fraction of the matrix learning rate (e.g., `UNEMBEDDING_LR = 0.0001`) to slow down the output layer updates and prevent overfitting to the heads.

title: matrix_lr_shaq
spec: Reduce the learning rate for the matrix parameters to a smaller fraction of the scalar learning rate (e.g., `MATRIX_LR = 0.001`) to slow down the core transformation updates and improve the quality of the learned embeddings.

title: gradient_accumulation_with_tortoise
spec: Introduce an optional variable `use_tortoise_ga` that toggles between gradient accumulation with a fixed window size and a variable window size based on the number of accumulated gradients, which is a technique to reduce variance in the gradient estimation.

title: Lower Temperature for LM Head
spec: Decrease UNEMBEDDING_LR from 0.004 to 0.0004 to improve the loss landscape for the output projection layer.

title: Lower Temp LM Head
spec: Reduce the temperature parameter passed to the language model (lm_head) output by a small factor (e.g., from 1.0 to 0.9 or 0.8) to soften the categorical softmax and encourage smoother probability distributions without changing the weights.

title: Reduced Adam B
spec: Lower ADAM_BETAS from (0.8, 0.95) to (0.1, 0.99) to reduce momentum smoothing and potentially speed up convergence.

title: Layer-Specific Learning Rate
spec: Apply different learning rates per layer rather than globally: high LR for input layers, low LR for output layers, and intermediate for hidden layers, using a linear or cosine interpolation schedule.

title: Time budget exploitation
spec: Add logic to increase WARMUP or FINAL_LR_FRAC to better utilize the 300s wall-clock time, making the model better optimized within the strict time window.

title: Warm down ratio increase
spec: Change WARMDOWN_RATIO from 0.5 to 0.75. Extending the warm-down phase can smooth the learning rate decay and improve convergence near the minimum.

title: Increase model depth
spec: Change DEPTH from 8 to 10. Deeper models can capture more complex patterns, potentially lowering val_bpb if capacity is sufficient.

title: Adjust aspect ratio
spec:
Change ASPECT_RATIO from 64 to 48. This changes model_dim/
depth relationship, altering the effective width/depth tradeoff. A wider, shallower model might generalize better.

title: AdamBetas adjustment for different convergence
spec: Try ADAM_BETAS = (0.999, 0.9999). This is a common variation that sometimes converges faster.

title: Adjust betas
spec: Change ADAM_BETAS from (0.8, 0.95) to (0.9, 0.999). Standard Adam betas often perform better for general language models than the overcustomized values here.

title: Gradient norm scaling
spec: Add if available a dynamic clip or norm scaling strategy for gradients (if changes are allowed). If not, just rely on the lower WEIGHT_DECAY and increased batch size.

title: Reduce weight decay
spec: Change WEIGHT_DECAY from 0.2 to 0.05. Lower regularization can lead to slightly better fitting of the model, potentially lowering val_bpb if the model was previously over-regularized.

title: Reduce warmup ratio
spec: Change WARMUP_RATIO from 0.0 to 0.05. A small warmup can help stabilize early training steps and prevent unlearning if the initial gradients are too sharp.

title: Window pattern adaptation
spec: Change WINDOW_PATTERN from 'SSSL' to 'SSSS' to increase the effective attention window without expanding the depth, potentially improving global token dependencies.

title: Conservative warmup schedule
spec: Set WARMUP_RATIO to a very low value (e.g., 0.01) and rely on a more gradual warmdown. This assumes the model can initialize and benefits from immediate optimization.

title: Rescale fine-tuning
spec: If possible, change UNEMBEDDING_LR to a higher value (e.g., 0.1) since LM head often needs more aggressive updates to fit to the target distribution quickly.

title: Boost matrix lr
spec: Change MATRIX_LR from 0.04 to 0.08. Increasing the global matrix learning rate can speed up the training of transformer attention layers.

title: Curriculum initialization in schedule
spec: Modify the schedule to start at a higher learning rate and decay faster (e.g., change WARMDOWN_RATIO downwards to accelerate decay early if initial LR is high).

title: Micro-batch Strategy for Gradient Stability
spec: Replace the large DEVICE_BATCH_SIZE with a chunked micro-batching strategy where the 300s budget is split into smaller gradient accumulation steps to reduce variance and improve convergence stability.

title: Asymmetric Aspect Ratio Experiment
spec: Reduce DEPTH from 8 to 6 but increase HEAD_DIM from 128 to 256 while keeping model_dim roughly constant, testing if higher dimensionality with fewer layers improves generalization on the new data.

title: Increase embedding learning rate
spec: Change EMBEDDING_LR from 0.6 to 1.0. Higher embedding LR can accelerate convergence on the dominant learning rate schedule.

title: Soft Weight Decay Masking
spec: Apply weight decay only to the weight matrices and skip scaling parameters during the Adam update step, isolating the regularization effect to reduce overall gradient noise.

title: Warmup with cosine
spec: Set WARMUP_FACTOR=0.1 and WARMUP_TYPE="cosine"

title: Linear Warmup + decay
spec: Replace WARMUP_RATIO=0.0 with WARMUP_FACTOR=0.1 to start лампы over time, then decay

title: Residual scaling
spec: Add pre-loop scaling for residual connections to reduce VBP

title: Batch normalization
spec: Add batch norm to attention output if sparse

title: Time-Aware Learning Rate Decay
spec: Modify the time-based LR schedule to decay the learning rate based on a power-law function of wall-clock time elapsed since start of training rather than training steps. Specifically, lr = lr_initial / (1 + (t / t_warmup)**0.7) where t is time elapsed.

title: Asymmetric Adam With Gradient-Rejection Warmedown
spec: Extend the MuonAdamW optimizer to asymmetrically decay beta2 (beta2_decay_ratio > 0) based on the magnitude of the gradient. When gradients are small, accelerate the running variance (lower beta2), allowing rapid forgetting of low-magnitude updates to reduce overfitting. When large, slow the variance decay to stabilize. Use a warmdown factor of 0.85.

title: Hybrid Batch Size Scheduling
spec: Switch between varying batch sizes based on the iteration count, using a larger batch size for the first half of training to warm up the model and smaller batches for fine-tuning.

title: Sparse Activation Filtering by Layer Index
spec: Compute the L2 norm of the activation posteriors for each layer. Apply a weight decay penalty only to parameters belonging to the top-k layers (by activation magnitude) with the highest magnitude of their posteriors. This targets the most active layers for regularization, ignoring the tail layers.

title: Hessian-Approximated Weight Decay
spec: Use a second-order approximation of the loss Hessian for adaptive weight decay, focusing regularization on parameters with high curvature to reduce overfitting.

title: Gradient Norm Accumulation
spec: Switch the optimizer step to accumulate gradients over n steps before updating weights using `torch.nn.utils.weight_decay` with accumulation normalization to reduce optimizer noise and improve training stability.

title: Cosine-LR with Fixed-Delta Decay
spec: Implement a cosine annealing schedule but ensure the final learning rate is exactly zero by forcing a decay step of delta_L = lr_current - lr_target to be zero at the very end. Use a fixed delta of 0.0001 times the initial LR to prevent late overfitting during the final seconds.

title: Increase WARMDOWN_RATIO from 0.5 to 0.7
spec: Set WARMDOWN_RATIO = 0.7 to extend the LR decay phase, allowing more refined tuning late in training.

title: Increase WARMUP_RATIO to 0.3
spec: Set WARMUP_RATIO = 0.3 to allow a longer warmup phase, potentially smoothing early updates.

title: Change UNEMBEDDING_LR from 0.004 to 0.01
spec: Increase UNEMBEDDING_LR to provide stronger updates to the LM head, potentially improving calibration.

title: Decrease UNEMBEDDING_LR to 0.001
spec: Reduce UNEMBEDDING_LR to make LM head updates more conservative, possibly lowering bpb.

title: Reduce WARMUP_RATIO from 0.0 to 0.1
spec: Set WARMUP_RATIO = 0.1 instead of 0.0 to introduce a small learning rate ramp, which can improve stability and convergence.

title: Increase WEIGHT_DECAY to 0.5
spec: Increase weight decay to 0.5 to aggressively shrink parameters, which may directly improve val_bpb.

title: Reduce WEIGHT_DECAY from 0.2 to 0.05
spec: Decrease weight decay to reduce regularization, allowing parameters to grow larger and potentially lower LLB.

title: Decrease WARMDOWN_RATIO to 0.3
spec: Set WARMDOWN_RATIO = 0.3 to accelerate the LR reduction, potentially reducing overfitting.

title: Larger ASPECT_RATIO
spec: Increase ASPECT_RATIO from 64 to 128 to allow more depth while reducing context-size pressure, reducing effective val_bpb.

title: U+L for Attention
spec: Add U+L loss term for attention layers to encourage unit preservation and lower validation perplexity bits.

title: Longer LRA decay schedule
spec: Set WARMUP_RATIO and WARMDOWN_RATIO to be symmetric and long (e.g., 0.6 and 0.8) to smooth learning over the full schedule.

title: Matrix-Only Warmup
spec: Set WARMUP_RATIO to 0.0 but introduce a conditional ramp for MATRIX_LR that starts at 0.1 and decays to 0.0 over the first 10% of steps, while keeping UNEMBEDDING_LR static at 0.004 to focus regularization flow.

title: Deeper Narrower Architecture
spec: Decrease DEPTH to 4 and increase ASPECT_RATIO to 256 to fit a much deeper model into a single A100 attempt, trading immediate training stability for a theoretically more powerful architecture that might generalize better.

title: Increase MatMul Learning Rate
spec: Increase MATRIX_LR from 0.04 to 0.08 to accelerate deeper layer updates which may be vectorized slower.

title: Set LR with Mariage for XtRem
spec: Implement the scheduled learning rate method 'marriage' to iteratively tune parameters via time-dependent steps.

title: Add bias to final layer
spec: Add bias=True to lm_head (Final) to reduce biasing error and improve final fit on small model.

title: Use AdamW instead of Adam
spec: Switch to AdamW optimizer for better weight decay application and faster convergence on transformers.

title: Cosine warmup instead of ramps
spec: Replace linear warmup with cosine warmup from 0.0 to 0.0001 over WARMUP_RATIO fraction to improve early gradient flow.

title: Change label smoothing
spec: Add label smoothing of 0.05 to lm_loss to reduce overconfidence in early training phases.

title: Reduce weight decay
spec: Lower WEIGHT_DECAY from 0.2 to 0.01 to allow softer regularization and faster convergence for small model.

title: Add bias to attention
spec: Add bias=True to Attention layers to reduce steering error and improve convergence on small model.

title: Increase batch size ratio
spec: Set DEVICE_BATCH_SIZE to 80 (if VRAM allows) to increase effective batch size and accelerate convergence.

title: Gradient accumulation reduction
spec: Reduce GANN_STEP to 4 (from default 8) to increase effective per-step gradient magnitude for faster convergence on small batch.

title: Use reduced warmup fraction with linear remainder
spec: Decrease WARMUP_RATIO from 0.1 to 0.03, keeping the schedule linear but strictly bounded to a smaller fraction of training steps. This encourages more rapid gradient exposure to complex behaviors.

title: Increase depth to 10 with lower per-layer parameters
spec: Set DEPTH to 10, ensuring ASPECT_RATIO and HEAD_DIM are scaled down to fit the model within the 800s wall-clock budget (total compute fits), while adding more layers can sometimes capture long-term dependencies better.

title: Add residual scaling by layer index to stabilize deep training
spec: Scale residual connections (bias added to output) by a factor that increases with depth (from 0.8 to 1.1) to improve gradient flow in deeper models.

title: LR boost
spec: Increase DETAILS_A multipliers to boost early learning rates significantly.

title: Total batch size increased
spec: Change TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE from 2**19 to 2**20 (exactly double the current 524k token target), assuming the GPU headroom allows it.

title: Momentum ramp
spec: Set momentum_ramp=False to avoid the penalty in early training.

title: Beta 2 increase
spec: Change ADAM_BETAS beta2 from 0.95 to 0.999, making the second moment more stable.

title: Weight decay
spec: Displace WEIGHT_DECAY from 0.2 to 0.1, reducing regularization strength and allowing for sharper updates.

title: Cosine ramp
spec: Replace the default decay schedule with cosine or other schedules for LR decay.

title: Optimization budget doubled
spec: Change OPTIMIZATION_BUDGET fraction from .5 to 1.0, ensuring all steps are optimized unless per-slot budget rules.

title: Beta ramp
spec: Set use_warmup_beta=True to be more cautious with the first few steps of training.

title: LR step
spec: Set warmup_steps=0 or 1000 (or similar) to allow a longer learning rate ramp-up phase.

title: Larger model
spec: Increase DEPTH to 12 (standard depth for smaller models), and maintain ASPECT_RATIO=64, resulting in roughly 3x parameters.

title: GradNorm Clipping
spec: Add 'gradnorm_clip' flag. Track the norm of gradients over the last N steps. If the norm exceeds a threshold, scale down all gradients by that factor to prevent large, destabilizing updates that can cause the loss to spike and the model to diverge.

title: Double Q
spec: Use a 'double Q' strategy to increase throughput and minimize loss.

title: Time-Distributed Adaptive Rate
spec: Add 'time_dist_lr' flag. Split the training loop into chunks and apply different learning rates per chunk based on the stability of the loss, automatically reducing the learning rate after any significant fluctuation (e.g., loss spiking) to prevent divergence.

title: QKV combine
spec: Merge attention heads or merge layers to improves flow through the model and reduce attention overhead.

title: Switch Adam to AdamW with Cosine Decay
spec: Change optimizer to AdamW with cosine LR scheduling (WARMUP_RATIO now effective, 0.0->0.1) and reduce lr by factor 2 after warmup.

title: Implement 4-Block Mixed Precision Checkpoints
spec: Switch to mixed precision computing (fp16) for matrix multiplications, but use fp32 for the loss and optimizer steps to improve gradient stability.

title: Add Grated Residual Reshaping Loss
spec: After the last transformer layer, reshape the embedding into a grid and apply L1 gradient to the mean pixel values of the final layer, encouraging uniformity across the grid representation.

title: Dynamic Learning Rate Scheduling with Warmup and Decay
spec: Switch to a dynamic LR schedule: WARMUP_RATIO (0.0->0.1), then linear warmdown for 0.9 of time, then sharp decay for final epoch.

title: Use Block-Matrix Dropout across Layers
spec: Define a dropout mask that only deactivates a subset of rows in each transformer layer's matrix, effectively sparsifying the gradients by half.

title: Enable Gradient Accumulation with Slower Micro-Batch Sizes
spec: Reduce TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE to 2**15 (32K tokens) per step and increase MICRO_BATCH_SIZE or manual accumulation steps to 16, slowing the gradient accumulation loop to allow better mixing of weights.

title: Reduce Aspect Ratio for Shallows Attention
spec: Decrease ASPECT_RATIO from 64 to 32, making heads more expressive but possibly allowing better generalization with fewer layers within the time budget.

title: Linear Learning Rate Schedule without Warmup
spec: Set WARMUP_RATIO to 0.0 and WARMDOWN_RATIO to 0.9 to apply only a linear decay for 90% of steps, removing the overhead of slow warmup that may not benefit this hyper-short training horizon.

title: Increase Production Weight Decay for Matrix Weights
spec: Raise WEIGHT_DECAY from 0.2 to 1.0 to aggressively suppress noise in the low-rank updates and stabilize the matrix parameters.

title: Introduce a Latent Class Backbone
spec: Insert a small 2NN recurrent module as an auxiliary backbone that outputs pseudo-embedding logits, concatenated with the last transformer layer before the lm_head.

title: Adaptive learning rate
spec: Use an adaptive learning rate scheme that adjusts the learning rate based on the gradient magnitude and other factors to improve the convergence of the model

title: Learning rate warmup schedule
spec: Modify the learning rate schedule to include a linear warmup phase followed by a cosine decay phase to improve the convergence of the model

title: Layer-wise learning rate scheduling
spec: Assign different learning rates to different layers of the model based on their depth to improve the convergence of the model

title: Weight initialization with attention layer
spec: Use a weight initialization scheme that is specifically designed for attention layers to improve the convergence of the model and prevent vanishing or exploding gradients

title: Weight initialization for deep models
spec: Use a weight initialization scheme that is tailored for deep models to improve the convergence of the model and prevent vanishing or exploding gradients

title: Learning rate schedule with plateau detection
spec: Modify the learning rate schedule to include a plateau detection mechanism that adjusts the learning rate based on the training loss over time

title: Memory-efficient transformer
spec: Use a memory-efficient transformer architecture that reduces the memory footprint of the transformer layers by using a smaller scratchpad size and more efficient attention mechanisms

title: Gradient checkpointing
spec: Enable gradient checkpointing in the training loop to reduce memory usage at the cost of increased computation during the forward pass

title: Memory-efficient attention
spec: Implement a memory-efficient attention mechanism that reduces the memory footprint of the attention layers by using a smaller scratchpad size

title: Gradient clipping based on layer-wise statistics
spec: Instead of global gradient clipping, apply per-layer gradient clipping based on the statistical distribution of activations in each layer to improve stability

title: Adaptive Gradient Regularization with Layer-Specific Coefficients
spec: Implement a function that dynamically adjusts the weight decay and gradient clipping thresholds per layer based on the local norm of the weight matrix, allowing deeper layers to have stronger regularization than shallower layers.

title: GradAccumulation with Adaptive LR
spec: Introduce grad_accumulation logic within the training loop to allow a larger TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE by accumulating gradients over multiple steps before backprop, while scaling the raw learning rate by 1/accumulation_steps to maintain convergence stability.

title: Cosine Annealing with Linear Warmup
spec: Change WARMUP_RATIO from 0.0 to a small value (e.g., 0.05) and switch WARMUP_RATIO behavior to use a Cosine annealing schedule with a linear warmup phase, reducing early learning rate spikes.

title: Linear Learning Rate Warmup
spec: Change WARMUP_RATIO from 0.0 to 0.05 and switch to a linear schedule without the exponential decay of the current schedule. This can provide a more consistent learning flow.

title: Gradient Checkpointing
spec: Implement gradient checkpointing (activation recomputation) on the transformer blocks. This trades compute for memory, allowing a larger DEVICE_BATCH_SIZE or smaller obvious forgetful layers to reduce val_bpb.

title: Deeper Model, Smaller Layers
spec: Increase DEPTH from 8 to 24. Since MODEL_HEIGHT is large, reducing head dimensions or optimizing per-layer learning rates can make the deeper model learn more abstract representations that lower val_bpb.

title: Adaptive Warmdown
spec: Replace static WARMDOWN_RATIO with a simple cosine decay schedule that ramps down the learning rate more aggressively in the later epochs of the 300s budget, reducing noise accumulation at the end.

title: Lookprobability Optimizer
spec: Implement a lookprobability optimizer which uses momentum to smooth out the gradients and stabilizes the training process, which improves val_bpb.

title: Symmetric LR Reduction Schedule
spec: Emerge to symmetric LR reduction schedule returning to where warmdown begins and ends with same as initial learning rate, which improves the validation bits per byte metric.

title: Bernstein Polynomials
spec: Replace the standard cosine LR schedule with a Bernstein polynomial approximation of the schedule. This can smooth out the learning rate curve more effectively than piece-wise linear steps, reducing oscillations.

title: Hard Gradient Clipping for Fewer Gradients
spec: Implement hard clipping of gradients to norm * L2 norm of feature maps to reduce gradient noise, improving val_bpb.

title: Warmdown phase extending
spec: Extend WARMDOWN_RATIO from 0.5 to 0.7 to ensure the learning rate gradually flattens over the final third of the 300s window instead of dropping abruptly.

title: Weight decay reduction
spec: Reduce WEIGHT_DECAY from 0.2 to 0.1 to lower regularization pressure during early training stages, allowing the model to fit the data without bias.

title: Embedding gradient scaling
spec: Increase EMBEDDING_LR from 0.6 to 1.2 and UNEMBEDDING_LR from 0.004 to 0.008 to allow embeddings to adapt more robustly, improving feature learning.

title: Scalar LR warmup
spec: Add warmup phases to SCALAR_LR starting with smaller values (e.g., 0.1) to gradually increase and prevent overshooting early activations.

title: Matrix weight decay
spec: Reduce WEIGHT_DECAY from 0.2 to 0.1 to soften regularization on the projection layers, allowing gradients to flow more directly during early training.

title: Scalar warmup ramp
spec: Apply a ramping ramp to SCALAR_LR that increases gradually from a low value to the target, ensuring that early updates are less aggressive than later ones.

title: Scalar LR boost
spec: Increase SCALAR_LR from 0.5 to 0.7 to account for per-layer scalar updates being slower to adapt to non-linear dynamics.

title: Asymmetric gradient accumulation
spec: Apply gradient accumulation strategies that dampen larger gradient updates in later training stages to control the effective learning rate based on accumulated history.

title: Residual Scale Tuning
spec: Reduce the initial input residuals by approximately 0.1 to 0.2 and empirically test if this subtle reduction in residual magnitude helps fine-tuning stability.

title: Weight decay schedule
spec: Implement a weight decay schedule whereyti is initially zero and increases slowly over time to reduce early clipping while focusing regularization later.

title: Asymmetric sliding window
spec: Change WINDOW_PATTERN from 'SSSL' to 'SSSL' or similar to ensure only a subset of windows are active at half context, reducing boundary effects without increasing total memory.

title: Embedding learning delay
spec: Add a small gradient masking or skip-cell logic to prevent embeddings from updating during the very first unweighted position embeddings, stabilizing initial dynamics.

title: Warmdown restructuring
spec: Replace the current WARMDOWN_RATIO of 0.5 with a higher fraction (e.g., 0.6) to provide a longer decay tail, smoothing LR transitions at the end of training.

title: Depth 6 same width

title: torch.compile max-autotune and fused ops for throughput
spec: Change the torch.compile call on the model to mode='max-autotune-no-cudagraphs' if it is not already set, keeping startup plus training under 450 s. Compile time is not counted in the 300 s of training, so the gain in step speed is free. If startup grows too much, revert to the default.

title: Cosine warmdown shape

title: Weight EMA for evaluation
spec: Keep an exponential moving average of the model parameters (decay 0.999, updated every step after the optimizer step with torch._foreach_lerp_ on a copied parameter list). Since the LR already decays to zero, check that EMA does not hurt. If it does not help, it is a bold test of averaging.

title: Sequence-length curriculum

This gives more tokens per second early. Keep the compiled model shapes limited to two variants by marking the shape change once, and make sure the final evaluation call is untouched.

spec: Replace the linear warmdown with a cosine shape over the same WARMDOWN_RATIO of the time budget.

title: Increase depth to 12 with narrower width
spec: Set DEPTH = 12 and ASPECT_RATIO = 43 so model_dim is about 512 (use 512 exactly, a multiple of HEAD_DIM 128 giving 4 heads). Keep everything else. Deeper and narrower models often trade steps for better per-token quality. If memory overflows at DEVICE_BATCH_SIZE 64, drop it to 32, which keeps TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE unchanged through grad accumulation.

title: QK-norm with learnable temperature and no-rope-free tweak: attention scale 1.2x
spec: After the existing q/k RMS norm (add it if absent), multiply q by a fixed scale factor of 1.2 (equivalent to a sharper attention softmax). Make it a constant in the attention forward pass, applied to q only, before calling flash attention or SDPA. Keep the softmax_scale default. Sharper attention often helps short training runs with QK-norm.

title: Matrix LR 0.05
spec: Raise MATRIX_LR from 0.04 to 0.05.

title: Adam beta2 0.99
spec: Change ADAM_BETAS to (0.8, 0.99) for smoother second-moment estimates.

title: Scalar LR 0.25
spec: Lower SCALAR_LR from 0.5 to 0.25 to stabilise the per-layer scalars.

title: Weight averaging (EMA) of parameters for evaluation
spec: Keep an exponential moving average of all model parameters, decay 0.999, updated every optimizer step with torch._foreach_lerp_ on a copy of the params. Just before the final evaluation call, swap the EMA weights into the model, so the harness evaluates the averaged model. Do not touch the evaluation call or summary printing. Insert the swap just before them and nothing else near them. If EMA hurts because of the warmdown, lower the decay to 0.99.

title: Weight decay 0.1
spec: Set WEIGHT_DECAY = 0.1. In a short run, less decay may help fit.

title: Warmdown ratio 0.3
spec: Set WARMDOWN_RATIO = 0.3 so more of the time is spent at full learning rate.

title: Z-loss on logits
spec: Add an auxiliary loss 1e-4 * mean(logsumexp(logits.float(), dim=-1)**2) to the training loss only, when targets are given in training. Do not change the evaluation loss path. Implement it in the model forward only if it is the training path, e.g. by computing it in the training loop from a separately returned value, or by a flag that is off during eval.

title: Embedding LR 0.4
spec: Lower EMBEDDING_LR from 0.6 to 0.4.

title: Window pattern all-short with final long layer
spec: Change WINDOW_PATTERN to "SSSSSSSL" for the 8 layers, so only the last layer has full attention (the code always forces the last layer to be L). This gives cheaper attention and more steps in 300 s. Leave the window size definition unchanged.

title: SwiGLU + WD 0.1 + batch 2**18 stack
spec: Combine the three best weak signals in one run: replace the relu^2 MLP with SwiGLU (hidden = 8/3*dim rounded up to a multiple of 64, gate and up projections, down projection, same init scale as the old MLP), set WEIGHT_DECAY = 0.1, and set TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE = 2**18. Leave everything else unchanged.

title: Depth 10
spec: Set DEPTH = 10 with ASPECT_RATIO = 51 (dim 510 → round to a multiple of 128 as the code does) or keep 64; test whether a bigger model wins despite fewer steps. Lower DEVICE_BATCH_SIZE to 32 if OOM.

title: Lower total batch to 2**18
spec: Set TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE = 2**18 (keep DEVICE_BATCH_SIZE 64 so grad accumulation drops from 8 to 4 steps). In a 300 s budget more optimizer steps usually help a small model. Nothing else changes.

title: HEAD_DIM 64
spec: Set HEAD_DIM = 64 giving twice as many attention heads at the same width. Check that the rotary and value-embedding code adapts via n_head computed from model_dim // HEAD_DIM.

title: Cosine-shaped warmdown
spec: Replace the linear warmdown multiplier with a cosine one: for progress p in the warmdown phase, lr_mult = FINAL_LR_FRAC + (1-FINAL_LR_FRAC)*0.5*(1+cos(pi*(1-remaining_fraction))). Keep the same WARMDOWN_RATIO.

title: Depth 6 wider-per-time
spec: Set DEPTH = 6 (model_dim = 384 with ASPECT_RATIO 64; if HEAD_DIM 128 needs it, keep dim a multiple of 128). This yields faster steps and more tokens in 300 s. Verify the dim is divisible by HEAD_DIM, otherwise set ASPECT_RATIO = 85 to get 512.

title: ReLU squared to SwiGLU-lite
spec: Replace the MLP activation relu(x)^2 by a gated SiLU MLP with hidden size 8/3*dim rounded to a multiple of 64 so the parameter count stays equal. Update init for the new gate projection.

title: Value-embedding on all layers
spec: If value embeddings are applied only on alternating layers, apply them to every layer (adds parameters in embeddings, cheap compute). If already on all layers, remove them from the first layer.

title: Final LR fraction 0.05
spec: Set FINAL_LR_FRAC = 0.05 so that the LR does not hit exactly zero at the end of the time budget.

title: Total batch 2**17
spec: Set TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE = 2**17 with DEVICE_BATCH_SIZE 64 (accum 2). Consider lowering MATRIX_LR slightly to 0.035 if desired, but keep the change minimal: only the batch size.

title: Matrix LR 0.05
spec: Set MATRIX_LR = 0.05 for the Muon matrices.

title: Short warmup
spec: Set WARMUP_RATIO = 0.03 to stabilize the first steps, which is especially useful if the batch size is reduced.

title: Warmdown ratio 0.3 with higher unembedding LR
spec: Set WARMDOWN_RATIO = 0.3 and UNEMBEDDING_LR = 0.008 together. A shorter warmdown spends more of the budget at peak LR, and a faster lm_head Adam LR suits the short budget. This is a bolder two-knob change, so keep the rest of the file as is.

title: Depth 4 wider model
spec: Set DEPTH = 4 and ASPECT_RATIO = 128 so model_dim is 512 (4 heads of 128). Fewer layers give faster steps, and the width is kept so capacity stays similar. Keep other hyperparameters unchanged. Check that the dim is a multiple of HEAD_DIM.

title: Untie init: zero-init output projections
spec: Ensure that attention c_proj and MLP c_proj are zero-initialized, if they are not already. If they are, scale the init of the lm_head by 0.5 instead.

title: Muon momentum 0.97 and Adam beta2 0.99
spec: Change the Muon momentum ramp so it ends at 0.97 instead of its current final value, and set ADAM_BETAS to (0.9, 0.99). Both are common choices for short runs. This one change touches optimizer smoothing only.

title: Batch 2**16 no accumulation
spec: Set TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE = 2**16 so that with DEVICE_BATCH_SIZE 64 and sequence length 2048 each step needs no accumulation (or minimal). Leave the other hyperparameters unchanged. Small-batch regimes give many more optimizer steps in the fixed 300 s. If unstable, scale MATRIX_LR by 0.7.

title: Muon momentum ramp to 0.97
spec: Change the Muon momentum schedule so that the final momentum is 0.97 (instead of the current value, probably 0.95), ramped as the code currently does. If the schedule is time-based, keep the ramp timing.

title: Batch 2**17 plus warmup 0.03 and warmdown 0.3
spec: Combine TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE = 2**17, WARMUP_RATIO = 0.03 and WARMDOWN_RATIO = 0.3 in one run. Each was a small gain individually, so test whether they stack.

title: Weight decay 0.1
spec: Set WEIGHT_DECAY = 0.1 for Muon cautious weight decay; short runs often need less regularization.

title: Muon momentum warmup shorter
spec: Shorten the Muon momentum warmup (0.85→0.95) to ~100 steps, or start at 0.9, if the schedule currently ramps over 300 steps.

title: Weight decay 0.1
spec: Set WEIGHT_DECAY = 0.1 for cautious Muon weight decay; short training may want less regularization.

title: Lower total batch to 2**17
spec: Set TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE = 2**17 with DEVICE_BATCH_SIZE 64 (accumulation of 2 steps of 64x2048). Many more steps; may need MATRIX_LR unchanged. Test the extreme of the small-batch trend.

title: Short warmup 0.02
spec: Set WARMUP_RATIO = 0.02 to smooth the first steps, especially with Muon and the high embedding LR.

title: Embedding LR 0.4
spec: Lower EMBEDDING_LR from 0.6 to 0.4 to see whether the token embedding Adam LR is too aggressive.

title: Warmdown ratio 0.3
spec: Set WARMDOWN_RATIO = 0.3 to keep high LR longer before decay.

title: Untied-free: add QK-norm learnable temperature and bigger attention scale
spec: After RMS-normalizing q and k in attention, multiply q by a learnable per-head scalar parameter initialized to 1.2 (treated as a scalar param in the SCALAR_LR Adam group, no weight decay). This sharpens attention, which often helps short training runs.

title: Muon with Nesterov off and higher LR 0.06 with NS steps 4
spec: Set MATRIX_LR = 0.06 and reduce Newton-Schulz iterations to 4 in the Muon step to save compute per step; this trades orthogonalization precision for throughput. Keep everything else unchanged.

title: Exponential moving average of weights for eval
spec: Maintain an EMA copy of model parameters (decay 0.999, updated every step in bf16/fp32 under no_grad, using torch._foreach_lerp_) and swap the EMA weights in just before the final evaluation call, restoring nothing afterwards. Do not alter the evaluation call itself. Start EMA at the init and use decay min(0.999, (1+step)/(10+step)).

title: Combine small gains: WD 0.1, batch 2**18, warmup 0.02
spec: In one run set WEIGHT_DECAY = 0.1, TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE = 2**18 (grad accumulation of 2 micro-batches of 64x2048 → adjust so tokens per step match, i.e. accumulation steps derived from TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE / (DEVICE_BATCH_SIZE*MAX_SEQ_LEN)), and WARMUP_RATIO = 0.02. Tests whether the individually small improvements stack.

title: Cosine-shaped warmdown instead of linear
spec: Replace the linear warmdown portion of the LR multiplier with a cosine decay: during warmdown with fraction p in [0,1] of warmdown elapsed, multiplier = FINAL_LR_FRAC + (1-FINAL_LR_FRAC)*0.5*(1+cos(pi*p)). Keep WARMDOWN_RATIO 0.5. Applies to all optimizer groups, and Muon momentum schedule unchanged.

title: Depth 12 with narrower aspect ratio 48
spec: Set DEPTH = 12 and ASPECT_RATIO = 48 (model_dim 576; ensure dim is a multiple of HEAD_DIM=128 by rounding up to 640 if the code does not round itself). This gives a deeper, thinner model at similar parameter count; check that DEVICE_BATCH_SIZE 64 still fits in memory, else drop to 32 with gradient accumulation.

title: Depth 6 wider-faster
spec: Set DEPTH = 6 (model dim 384 with ASPECT_RATIO 64) for more steps in 300 s; alternatively keep dim by setting ASPECT_RATIO = 85 so dim ~512. Test whether a smaller model wins in fixed time.

title: Head dim 64
spec: Set HEAD_DIM = 64 for more attention heads at same width.

title: Scalar LR 0.25
spec: Halve SCALAR_LR from 0.5 to 0.25 for per-layer scalars.

title: Replicate weight decay 0.1 with 0.05 variant
spec: Set WEIGHT_DECAY = 0.05 (cautious Muon weight decay) and change nothing else. Earlier 0.1 gave -0.0020 on a single run; this tests whether the trend continues to lower decay. Keep all other hyperparameters at current values.

title: Warmdown ratio 0.7 with final LR 0.05
spec: Set WARMDOWN_RATIO=0.7 and FINAL_LR_FRAC=0.05, so the learning rate decays linearly for the last 70% of the time budget and ends at 5% of peak rather than 0. Change nothing else.

title: Gradient clipping at 1.0
spec: After the backward pass over the micro-batches and before optimizer.step(), call torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(model.parameters(), 1.0). Keep all learning rates unchanged. If grads are scaled or unscaled anywhere, clip after that step.

title: Matrix LR 0.03
spec: Lower MATRIX_LR from 0.04 to 0.03 in case the current rate is too high for the shorter step budget.

title: Bolder: Muon LR 0.03 with a 2x larger unembedding LR
spec: Set MATRIX_LR=0.03 and UNEMBEDDING_LR=0.008 together. Smaller models with a short run may prefer a gentler Muon step and a faster-learning output head. Change nothing else.

title: Depth 6 wider-faster
spec: Set DEPTH = 6 (model_dim 384 with ASPECT_RATIO 64; consider ASPECT_RATIO 96 to keep width 576, dim must be a multiple of HEAD_DIM 128 — use 640 via ASPECT_RATIO 106 if needed). Smaller model trains more tokens in 300s.

title: Halve total batch size to 2**18
spec: Set TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE = 2**18 (keep DEVICE_BATCH_SIZE 64 so grad accumulation drops from 8 to 4 steps). In a fixed 300s budget, more optimizer steps usually help a small model.

title: Nonzero final LR fraction
spec: Set FINAL_LR_FRAC = 0.05 so training does not decay fully to zero.

title: Lower warmdown ratio to 0.3
spec: Set WARMDOWN_RATIO = 0.3 so more time is spent at peak LR before linear decay to zero.

title: Higher warmdown ratio 0.7
spec: Set WARMDOWN_RATIO = 0.7 to test a longer decay phase.

title: Lower logit softcap to 10
spec: In GPT.forward, find the logit softcap constant (probably 15) and change it to 10. Everything else is unchanged. Tighter capping can regularize the output distribution and stabilize training at high unembedding LR.

title: Embedding LR 0.4
spec: Set EMBEDDING_LR = 0.4 to test a lower Adam LR on token embeddings.

title: Window pattern SL with short window quarter context
spec: Change WINDOW_PATTERN to "SL" so that half the layers use full attention. Keep the final layer forced to full attention as the existing code does. If the S window is half the context, leave it. This tests whether more global attention beats the throughput cost.

title: Weight decay 0.1
spec: Set WEIGHT_DECAY = 0.1 for Muon cautious weight decay; short runs may prefer less regularization.

title: Gradient clipping at 1.0
spec: Before optimizer.step(), after the accumulated backward passes, call torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(model.parameters(), 1.0). Check that no existing clipping is present. Keep everything else unchanged. This stabilizes early high-LR steps and may allow a higher matrix LR.

title: Head dim 64
spec: Set HEAD_DIM = 64 giving more heads at same width; may help quality, check throughput with flash attention.

title: Bold: weight EMA for evaluation
spec: Keep an exponential moving average of model parameters (decay 0.999, updated every optimizer step, using torch._foreach_lerp_ on a copy of the parameters) and swap the EMA weights into the model right before the final evaluation call, without touching the evaluation call itself. Start EMA after the first 10% of steps. Cheap and can offset noise at the end of the warmdown.

title: QK-norm scale tweak
spec: If QK rms-norm is used, multiply q and k after normalisation by a learnable per-head scalar initialised to 1.2 (or a fixed factor 1.2) to sharpen attention.

title: Batch size 2**17 with matrix LR scaled
spec: Set TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE to 2**17 (grad accumulation drops to 2 with device batch 64) and multiply MATRIX_LR by 0.85 (to 0.034) to compensate. More optimizer steps in 300 s may help since 2**18 was slightly better than 2**19. Keep all else unchanged.

title: Short warmup 3% plus warmdown 0.4
spec: Set WARMUP_RATIO to 0.03 and WARMDOWN_RATIO to 0.4, keeping FINAL_LR_FRAC at 0. A brief warmup may stabilize early high-LR Muon/Adam steps, and a slightly shorter warmdown was neutral-to-positive earlier. Make sure the LR schedule function handles warmup progress correctly as a fraction of elapsed training time.

title: Matrix LR 0.05
spec: Set MATRIX_LR from 0.04 to 0.05. Everything else unchanged. Tests for a higher Muon learning rate under the 300s budget.

title: Short LR warmup of 2%
spec: Set WARMUP_RATIO = 0.02 so the LR ramps linearly from 0 to its peak over the first 2% of the time budget. Combined with the high Adam embedding LR, this may avoid damaging early steps. No other changes.

title: Bold: depth 10 with aspect ratio 51 and batch 2**18
spec: Set DEPTH = 10, ASPECT_RATIO = 51 (model_dim 510 rounds to a multiple of HEAD_DIM 128 as the code does; if the code requires divisibility, use ASPECT_RATIO 52 giving 520 → rounded up to 640 only if that is the code's behavior; otherwise keep width near 512), and TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE = 2**18 so a deeper model still gets enough steps. Ensure WINDOW_PATTERN still ends with a full-attention layer. Watch VRAM; lower DEVICE_BATCH_SIZE to 32 if needed.

title: Combine clip, final LR frac, warmdown 0.3
spec: In train.py set WARMDOWN_RATIO = 0.3 and FINAL_LR_FRAC = 0.05, and add global grad-norm clipping to 1.0 (torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(model.parameters(), 1.0)) after the accumulated backward passes and before optimizer.step(). Leave everything else unchanged. This tests whether the individually small gains stack.

title: Adam betas (0.9, 0.99)
spec: Change ADAM_BETAS from (0.8, 0.95) to (0.9, 0.99) for the embedding, unembedding and scalar Adam groups. Nothing else changes.

title: Weight decay 0.1
spec: Set WEIGHT_DECAY = 0.1 for Muon cautious weight decay. A short run may be under-trained rather than over-fit, so less decay might help.

title: Lower total batch to 2**18
spec: Set TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE = 2**18 (~262K tokens/step). With a fixed 300 s budget on an A100, more optimizer steps usually help a small model. Keep DEVICE_BATCH_SIZE 64 so grad accumulation drops accordingly. Make no other change.

title: Matrix LR 0.05
spec: Raise MATRIX_LR from 0.04 to 0.05 for Muon. Nothing else changes.

title: Gradient clipping 1.0
spec: Add torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(model.parameters(), 1.0) after the backward passes and before the optimizer step. This guards against early-training spikes at a high LR.

title: Warmdown ratio 0.7
spec: Set WARMDOWN_RATIO = 0.7 so the LR decays linearly over the last 70% of the time budget. Nothing else changes.

title: Depth 10 narrower
spec: Set DEPTH = 10 with ASPECT_RATIO = 51 so model_dim is about 512 (a multiple of 128). Deeper but similar-width model. Check that it fits in memory at DEVICE_BATCH_SIZE 64, and lower it to 32 if needed.

title: Depth 6 wider ratio
spec: Set DEPTH = 6 and ASPECT_RATIO = 85 (model_dim 510, which is rounded to a multiple of HEAD_DIM, i.e. 512 or 384 depending on the existing rounding). This gives a shallower, faster model that sees more tokens in 300 s. Verify the dimension is a multiple of HEAD_DIM.

title: Pattern SSSSL-like with shorter windows
spec: Set WINDOW_PATTERN = "SSL" for more full-attention layers. The last layer is always forced to be full by the existing code. Nothing else changes.

title: Warmdown ratio 0.3
spec: Set WARMDOWN_RATIO = 0.3 to leave more time at peak LR. Nothing else changes.

title: Head dim 64
spec: Set HEAD_DIM = 64 to get twice as many attention heads. Check that model_dim is divisible by 64. The attention kernel must support head dim 64; flash attention does.

title: Short warmup
spec: Set WARMUP_RATIO = 0.03 to add a brief LR warmup. This may stabilize the early high-LR Muon and Adam phases.

title: Adam beta1 0.9
spec: Set ADAM_BETAS = (0.9, 0.95). Nothing else changes.

title: Final LR fraction 0.05
spec: Set FINAL_LR_FRAC from 0.0 to 0.05 so the LR does not decay fully to zero at the end of warmdown. Change nothing else.

title: Weight decay linearly decayed to zero
spec: Make Muon cautious weight decay follow the schedule: multiply the weight decay by the same LR multiplier used for the LR each step, so it decays to zero during warmdown. Implement by updating the group's weight_decay each step alongside the LR update. Keep the base WEIGHT_DECAY 0.2.

title: Matrix LR 0.03
spec: Lower MATRIX_LR from 0.04 to 0.03. Nothing else changes.

title: Scalar LR 0.25
spec: Halve SCALAR_LR from 0.5 to 0.25, for the per-layer scalars. Nothing else changes.

title: Total batch 2**17
spec: Set TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE to 2**17 (~131K tokens per step) with DEVICE_BATCH_SIZE 64 so gradient accumulation becomes 2 steps. More optimizer steps in the fixed 300 s budget suit the small depth-6 model. Change nothing else.

title: Embedding LR 0.3
spec: Set EMBEDDING_LR from 0.6 to 0.3 for the token embedding Adam group. Change nothing else.

title: Muon momentum warmup shorter
spec: Change the Muon momentum schedule so it ramps from 0.85 to 0.95 over the first 100 steps instead of the current length (or set a final momentum of 0.97 if there is no ramp). Edit only the momentum function.

title: Head dim 64
spec: Set HEAD_DIM = 64 for more attention heads at the same width.

title: Shorter warmdown
spec: Set WARMDOWN_RATIO = 0.3 so more time is spent at full LR.

title: Batch 2**18 with higher LR
spec: Combine TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE = 2**18 with MATRIX_LR = 0.05 and EMBEDDING_LR 0.7 to compensate for noisier gradients.

title: Aspect ratio 80
spec: Set ASPECT_RATIO = 80 at DEPTH 8 (dim 640, 5 heads of 128), wider model.

title: Higher unembedding LR
spec: Set UNEMBEDDING_LR = 0.008.

title: Combine lm_head LR 0.008 with ASPECT_RATIO 80
spec: Set UNEMBEDDING_LR = 0.008 and ASPECT_RATIO = 80 (dim 640, 5 heads of head_dim 128) in one run. Both single changes beat the incumbent individually (-0.0031 and -0.0022); this tests whether the gains stack. No other changes.

title: Muon momentum warmup shorter
spec: Shorten the Muon momentum ramp (e.g. from 300 steps to 100 steps) and use final momentum 0.97.

title: Short warmup plus nonzero final LR
spec: Set WARMUP_RATIO = 0.03 and FINAL_LR_FRAC = 0.05. Warmup stabilizes early steps with the high Adam LRs, and a small final LR avoids wasting the last steps of the budget. Both are schedule-only changes.

title: Depth 10
spec: Set DEPTH = 10 with DEVICE_BATCH_SIZE 32 if needed for memory, to test a larger model.

title: Gradient clipping at 1.0 plus higher matrix LR 0.06
spec: Add torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(model.parameters(), 1.0) before the optimizer step (after the gradient accumulation loop), and set MATRIX_LR = 0.06. Clipping protects against instabilities from the more aggressive LR.

title: Lower logit softcap to 10
spec: Find the logit softcap constant (likely 15) in the GPT forward pass and set it to 10. One-number change.

title: Lower total batch to 2**18
spec: Set TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE = 2**18 (grad accumulation halves). In a fixed 300s budget, more optimizer steps usually help a small model. Keep DEVICE_BATCH_SIZE 64.

title: Small warmup
spec: Set WARMUP_RATIO = 0.03 to stabilize early Muon/Adam steps.

title: Longer warmdown with 0.7 ratio
spec: Set WARMDOWN_RATIO to 0.7 and keep FINAL_LR_FRAC at 0. Since a shorter warmdown did nothing, test the opposite direction with a bolder value.

title: Sliding window pattern SSSSL-free: all short except last layer
spec: Set WINDOW_PATTERN = "SSSSSSSL" so only the final layer uses full context and the rest use half-context windows. This cuts attention cost, giving more steps in the time budget. Check that the code forces the last layer to be long regardless.

title: Depth 6 wider-time tradeoff
spec: Set DEPTH = 6 (model_dim 384 from ASPECT_RATIO 64) for more steps within 300s; check dim divisible by HEAD_DIM, or set ASPECT_RATIO=64 and HEAD_DIM=128 as-is.

title: Depth 6 with ASPECT_RATIO 96
spec: Set DEPTH = 6 and ASPECT_RATIO = 96 (dim 576, rounded to a multiple of HEAD_DIM 128 if the code needs it, i.e. 640 via ASPECT_RATIO 107, or adjust to 5 heads). A shallower, wider model runs faster per step and sees more tokens in 300 s. Keep other hyperparameters unchanged.

title: Weight decay schedule decaying to zero
spec: Make Muon weight decay scale linearly with the LR multiplier (or decay faster toward 0 during warmdown).

title: Cosine-shaped warmdown
spec: Replace the linear warmdown multiplier with a cosine shape: during the warmdown phase use lr_mult = FINAL_LR_FRAC + (1-FINAL_LR_FRAC)*0.5*(1+cos(pi*(1-cooldown_fraction))) where cooldown_fraction runs from 1 to 0 over the warmdown. Keep WARMDOWN_RATIO at 0.5.

title: Adam beta2 0.99 for embeddings and scalars
spec: Change ADAM_BETAS from (0.8, 0.95) to (0.9, 0.99). Smaller batches give noisier gradients, so more smoothing in the Adam groups may help. One-line change.

title: ReLU^2 MLP to SwiGLU at matched params
spec: Replace the MLP with SwiGLU, with hidden size = round(8/3*dim) rounded to a multiple of 64, so the parameter count stays the same as the 4x ReLU^2 MLP. Use 3 bias-free linear layers.

title: Matrix LR 0.05
spec: Set MATRIX_LR = 0.05 for Muon. Check whether the optimum is higher at this short training horizon.

title: Weight decay 0.1
spec: Set WEIGHT_DECAY = 0.1 for Muon's cautious weight decay. Little regularization is needed in a sub-epoch regime.

title: Depth 6 wider-per-step
spec: Set DEPTH = 6 (model_dim = 384 at ASPECT_RATIO 64). A smaller model gets more tokens in 300 s. Make sure model_dim is a multiple of HEAD_DIM; if not, round up.

title: Warmdown ratio 0.3
spec: Set WARMDOWN_RATIO = 0.3 so more of the time budget is spent at peak LR, keeping FINAL_LR_FRAC 0.
