At the end of train(), copy the EMA values into the model's parameters so predict() uses them. Reset the EMA buffers at the start of each train() call, and do not touch them in predict(). Keep BatchNorm running stats as they are.

title: Spatial head instead of global max pool
spec: Replace the final nn.AdaptiveMaxPool2d(1) with a flatten of the 4x4 map of block 3, so the head input is 256*4*4 = 4096 features instead of 256. Keep the head as a bias-free linear layer to 10 classes, but scale its input by one over the square root of the new fan-in as in the existing scaled head, and keep the head learning rate and weight decay rule unchanged. The block-3 output must be 4x4 when the input is 32x32 and 3x3 at the 24x24 stage, so either use AdaptiveAvgPool2d(4) before flattening to keep the head size fixed, or take the max over the spatial dimension for the low-resolution stages. The change adds a head with more parameters but almost no compute.

title: Sign-based updates for scalar and bias parameters
spec: Replace the Nesterov SGD optimizer for the whiten bias, the norm biases and the head with a Lion-style update. Keep an fp32 momentum buffer per parameter with beta1 = 0.9 for the update direction and beta2 = 0.99 for the buffer, then apply the update as p -= lr * sign(beta1 * m + (1 - beta1) * g), with weight decay applied as the decoupled term p *= (1 - lr * wd). Keep the existing per-group linear learning-rate decay to zero and the existing learning rates scaled by about 0.3 to start, since sign updates have unit magnitude. Muon stays unchanged for the convolution filters. The implementation should use torch._foreach ops or a single fused loop so the optimizer cost stays small.

title: Head LR higher, bias LR lower
spec: Set HEAD_LR = 0.65 and BIAS_LR = 0.05. A small retune of the SGD groups.

title: Remove first-conv dirac init
spec: In Conv.reset_parameters remove the dirac_ initialisation of the first channels so the init is plain default. Test whether the identity init is really helping.

title: Warmup of Muon LR over first 10 steps
spec: Multiply the lr_factor2 for the Muon group by min(1, (step+1)/10), a short linear warmup. This may allow slightly higher MUON_LR stability early.

title: Precompute all epoch augmentations less often
spec: Perform batch_color_jitter on only the indexed batch (images[idxs]) rather than the full 50000 images per epoch, or conversely generate crop per batch. Compare time; reduces memory traffic for the final partial epoch (7.65 epochs means the last epoch is only 65 percent used).

title: Disable color jitter
spec: Set the color_jitter enabled False in train aug. This removes two elementwise kernels per epoch and may lose little accuracy in a 7-epoch regime.

title: Half-precision whitening init on fewer samples
spec: In train, use train_loader.images[:480] instead of 960 for init_whiten. Slightly cheaper SVD and patch extraction.

title: Progressive resolution training
spec: In train(), for the first ~40% of steps feed inputs downsampled to 24x24 (F.interpolate with mode='bilinear', antialias off, applied to each batch after indexing) and then switch to full 32x32 for the remainder. The network is fully convolutional up to the final MaxPool2d(3), so the head size stays valid if the final pool is replaced with adaptive max pooling to 1x1 (nn.AdaptiveMaxPool2d(1)); at 32x32 input the feature map is 4x4 -> the same as MaxPool(3) giving 1x1 so use adaptive pooling for both. Mark the shape change as one extra compile (shapes are fixed per phase; warm-up compile happens in the untimed first call). Keep total epochs the same or raise them slightly if accuracy drops.

title: EMA of weights over final steps for evaluation
spec: Keep an exponential moving average (decay ~0.9) of all model parameters and BN running stats only during the last ~25% of training steps using torch._foreach_lerp_ on fp16 copies, then copy EMA into the model at the end of train(). Because LR decays to zero this may help little, so combine with a 5% reduction of EPOCHS (7.25) to trade for time. Use fused foreach ops to keep overhead low.

title: Channels 256 to 192 in blocks 2 and 3 with higher Muon LR
spec: Set widths to block1=64, block2=192, block3=192 in CifarNet and increase EPOCHS slightly (7.9). Smaller convs cut the dominant FLOPs by about 40 percent in blocks 2 and 3. Keep the Muon code unchanged (it pads to max dims automatically). Multiply MUON_LR by 1.1 to compensate for smaller filters.

title: Fused flip and translate in a single per-epoch pass without padded copy
spec: Replace the reflect pad + gather-based batch_crop with a cheaper per-epoch approach: pick one random shift (dx,dy) in [-2,2] per group of 8 sub-batches... Simpler: generate per-epoch translated images using torch.roll on 5 random shift groups (split the 50000 images into 5 chunks by random permutation and roll each chunk by a different (dx,dy) in {-2..2}^2 using torch.roll). Roll wraps rather than reflects, which is acceptable at 2 pixels. This removes the advanced-indexing gather kernel, which is memory-bound on 50000x3x32x32.

title: Translate 1 instead of 2
spec: Set TRANSLATE = 1 so less augmentation fits the short training. Check accuracy gain.

title: Replace SiLU with GELU everywhere
spec: Replace nn.SiLU in ConvGroup with nn.GELU. The two are close and GELU may fuse differently under compile. Check cost.

title: Cosine-free Muon with 2 Newton-Schulz iterations
spec: In _zeropower_via_newtonschulz5, delete the third unrolled Newton-Schulz iteration (keep two). Compensate by raising MUON_LR by 5 percent. This cuts matmul time in the optimizer, which is performed every step on padded 256x2304 stacks.

title: Low-res phase for first 40% at 20x20 then 32
spec: Change the downsample in the training loop to size (20, 20) rather than 24x24 for step < 0.3*total_train_steps. Note compile uses fixed shapes: this yields only two shapes so recompiles happen once in warmup (untimed). Speeds early steps further. Make sure the dynamo recompile does not break: shapes are static since automatic_dynamic_shapes is False.

title: BatchNorm momentum change
spec: Set BatchNorm default momentum parameter (the value 0.5566) to 0.45 so running stats track recent weights better for the final model at test time.

title: Lower whitening-bias epochs to 0.1
spec: Set WHITEN_BIAS_EPOCHS = 0.1 so the whiten bias is frozen sooner. This slightly reduces backward work in early steps. Check for any accuracy effect.

title: Reduce width of block2 and block3 to 224
spec: Set widths block2=224 and block3=224 (multiples of 32 for tensor cores). This reduces conv FLOPs by about 25 percent. Compensate with nothing initially and compare cost.

title: Half-precision TTA batch 5000
spec: Increase the inference batch sizes B and tta_batch_size from 2000 to 5000, so there are fewer launches. This is a minor speed gain at identical outputs.

title: Remove color jitter
spec: Disable color_jitter in the train aug config (enabled False). This saves a kernel pass and tests whether it matters at 7.65 epochs.

title: Progressive resolution
spec: For the first ~40% of steps, train on 24x24 downsampled (interpolated) inputs, then switch to 32x32. The conv net is size-agnostic apart from the final MaxPool(3). This reduces time. It needs compiled graphs for both shapes (use dynamic=False and mark them separately).

title: Widen block 3 to 320 and reduce epochs
spec: Set block3 width to 320 and cut EPOCHS to 7.0. A wider final block may be more sample-efficient.

title: Freeze whiten bias entirely
spec: Set WHITEN_BIAS_EPOCHS to 0 (or a tiny value) and pass whiten_bias_grad False always, so only one graph is compiled. This removes backward through the first conv input.

title: Drop to 2-view TTA (flip only)
spec: In _get_tta_logits, use only images_batch and its flip (2 views) instead of the 6 views with shifted crops. This cuts TTA compute by 3x. Keep the 25% uncertain quantile.

title: Translate 1 instead of 2
spec: Set TRANSLATE=1. Less augmentation may speed convergence in a short schedule and make the pad and crop cheaper.

title: Head scale tweak
spec: Change the output scaling in forward from division by x.size(-1) to a multiplication by 1/x.size(-1) times a factor 1.5 (a logit scale). Retune with HEAD_LR unchanged. It tests logit temperature with label smoothing.

title: Remove norm_freq rescaling of weights
spec: The Muon step periodically rescales filters to norm sqrt(D) via _foreach_norm. Replace the schedule with a fixed lower frequency (e.g. every 8 steps) to save kernel launches. Check accuracy.

title: Three-stage resolution ramp 16/24/32
spec: Replace the single low-res switch in train() with a ramp: for step < 0.25*total_train_steps interpolate inputs to (16,16), for step < 0.55*total_train_steps interpolate to (24,24), otherwise use full 32x32. Use bilinear, align_corners=False. Keep EPOCHS the same.

title: Ensemble-free EMA of weights for prediction
spec: Skip; instead replace with: Muon LR cosine-free warmup. Specifically, ramp the Muon and SGD learning rates linearly from 0.2x to 1x over the first 10 steps (lr_factor2 multiplied by min(1, 0.2 + 0.8*step/10)), then continue the existing linear decay. This may allow a higher peak MUON_LR of 0.23.

title: Block 1 width 48
spec: Reduce widths block1 from 64 to 48 (a multiple of 8 for tensor cores). This is cheap at the highest resolution. Keep the rest.

title: Replace max-autotune in forward_step with default
spec: Change torch.compile(mode='max-autotune') in forward_step to mode None (or max-autotune-no-cudagraphs). Compile time is untimed, but the runtime kernels may differ. It tests whether CUDA graphs help.

title: Weight decay increase
spec: Increase WEIGHT_DECAY from 1.04e-6 to 3e-6, so wd = WEIGHT_DECAY*batch. A tiny regularisation change that may help generalisation.

title: 28px low-res phase for 50% of steps
spec: In train(), change the low-res phase to use size (28, 28) and threshold 0.5 * total_train_steps. This tests a milder resolution drop held for longer.

title: Lower final LR floor: decay to 0 vs 0.02
spec: Change the linear decay lr_factor2 to max(0.02, 1 - step*base) or conversely use a nonlinear (cosine-ish) tail. This tests schedule shape for the Muon and SGD groups.

title: Longer 24px phase to 60% of steps
spec: In train(), change the condition `step < 0.4 * total_train_steps` to `step < 0.6 * total_train_steps`, keeping the 24x24 bilinear downsample. Keep everything else the same.

title: Fuse jitter into crop
spec: Compute batch_color_jitter on the cropped images fused in one compiled function with batch_crop, to avoid an extra full-memory pass. Behaviour is unchanged.

title: Muon momentum 0.75
spec: Set MUON_MOMENTUM from 0.655 to 0.75 for smoother orthogonalised updates. Leave the other settings unchanged.

title: Decoupled final-epoch no-augmentation
spec: For the last ~1 epoch, disable translate and color jitter (use the unpadded normalized images) so that the train distribution matches the test.

title: Use mode max-autotune-no-cudagraphs vs default
spec: Change forward_step's torch.compile mode to 'max-autotune-no-cudagraphs' to check whether time changes. Alternatively try mode=None if autotune picks poor kernels.

title: Final-block 2x pooling head change
spec: Replace the final MaxPool2d(3) with an adaptive average plus max pooling mix: 0.5*(max_pool + avg_pool) over 3x3. It is cheap and might improve accuracy.

title: Raise TTA fraction to 40%
spec: Change UNCERTAIN_QUANTILE from 0.25 to 0.4 to gain accuracy from more TTA; check whether the accuracy gain outweighs the added inference time.

title: Disable color jitter
spec: Set the color_jitter enabled flag to False in the train aug dict. This saves a kernel per epoch and tests whether the jitter is useful at all.

title: Batch size 1024
spec: Set BATCH_SIZE=1024 and lower MUON_LR to 0.18. More steps per epoch may allow fewer epochs (EPOCHS=7.0) at the same accuracy.

title: Narrow block2 to 192
spec: Set widths block2=192 (block3 stays 256) to cut the FLOPs of the heaviest block. Raise EPOCHS to 8.0 if needed to offset the accuracy loss.

title: Fade augmentation strength linearly
spec: In CifarLoader.__iter__, scale the brightness and contrast jitter ranges and use the translate crop only with a probability that decays with progress. Simplest: add attribute self.aug_scale set by train() each epoch as 1 - epoch/num_epochs, multiply brightness/contrast ranges by it. Keep the final-epoch clean behaviour. Pass floats to batch_color_jitter (a Python float change may recompile once; the untimed warm-up covers it only if values vary there, so instead pass the scale as a 0-dim cuda tensor multiplied inside the function).

title: EMA-free weight averaging of last steps
spec: In train(), keep a copy of the model parameters (conv filters, head, norm biases, whiten bias) and, for the final ~0.5 epoch (the last ~2 steps of the 7.65-epoch run, so use the last 3 steps), average parameters with a simple running mean via torch._foreach_add_/mul_. Before returning from train(), copy the averaged values into the model parameters. BatchNorm running stats are left as is. Use torch.no_grad. Keep code under 15 lines.

title: Skip TTA crops, use flip only for uncertain images
spec: In _get_tta_logits, drop the crop_tl and crop_br views and use base_views = images_batch only, with flipped views, giving 2 views instead of 6. Then raise UNCERTAIN_QUANTILE to 0.5 so the same number of forward passes is used but more images get mirror TTA. Aims to cut predict time while keeping accuracy.

title: Channels 64/256/256 to 96/256/256 with fewer epochs
spec: Change widths block1 to 96 only (the first block runs at the highest resolution, but is cheap relative to block2), and reduce EPOCHS from 7.65 to 7.2 to compensate time. Whiten width stays 24. Expect better accuracy per epoch from a wider early block.

title: Use ReLU activations
spec: Replace SiLU in ConvGroup with nn.ReLU (inplace False). It is cheaper and fuses more easily, so test the accuracy trade-off.

title: Two-epoch clean tail
spec: Change the train loop so train_loader.clean is True for the last two epochs (epoch >= ceil(total_train_steps/len(train_loader)) - 2) instead of only the last one, disabling translate and color jitter for both. Leave EPOCHS and all other settings unchanged.

title: Translate 1 pixel
spec: Set TRANSLATE=1, which gives less augmentation and a smaller padded tensor. Check whether accuracy holds for a short run.

title: Progressive resolution
spec: For the first ~40% of steps, train on images downsampled to 24x24 with F.interpolate (in the forward_step input). Then switch to 32x32. Compile handles both shapes. This saves compute in early epochs.

title: Progressive resolution early epochs
spec: For the first ~35% of training steps, train on 24x24 center-cropped or bilinearly downsampled-by-0.75 images (F.interpolate to 24x24, channels_last), then switch to full 32x32. Final epochs are full resolution. This reduces early-step compute; the compiled forward may recompile once per shape (done in untimed first call, since both shapes occur). Compensate by nothing else.

title: Lower Muon target magnitude end
spec: Change final_target_mag from 0.0786 to 0.05 and initial_target_mag to 0.55 to test a steeper update magnitude decay.

title: Whiten init on more patches
spec: Use train_loader.images[:2000] instead of [:960] in init_whiten for a better whitening covariance estimate. This costs little extra time.

title: Replace SiLU with GELU
spec: In ConvGroup, use nn.GELU instead of nn.SiLU. This tests an activation that may be cheaper or more accurate.

title: Channels width 64/192/256
spec: Change widths to block1=64, block2=192, block3=256 to cut conv FLOPs; compensate with nothing else. Test time-accuracy tradeoff.

title: Skip Muon on first conv-only odd steps
spec: Run the orthogonalization every step but compute Muon update for the big 256-wide convs only; alternatively apply Muon to all filters every step but use head SGD. Simplest: keep as is except set norm_freq schedule constant at 8 to reduce norm computations (group['norm_freq']=8).

title: Progressive resolution
spec: For the first ~40% of epochs, train on 24x24 random crops (or downscaled 0.75 images via F.interpolate) then switch to full 32x32; the network is fully convolutional with final MaxPool(3), so adjust nothing else. Saves compute early.

title: Decay to nonzero floor then zero
spec: Use lr factor max(0, 1 - step/(0.95*total_steps)) so the last 5% steps are at zero LR, saving nothing but test if EPOCHS can be cut; alternatively end schedule at 0 at 92% of steps and stop training early (total steps*0.92).

title: Drop TTA to mirror-only on uncertain set
spec: In infer's tta(), change _get_tta_logits to use only the original image and its flip (2 views) instead of 6 views (drop crop_tl/crop_br). This cuts predict time; check accuracy loss is small.

title: Fewer Newton-Schulz iterations (2)
spec: In _zeropower_via_newtonschulz5 remove the third unrolled iteration (keep 2 NS steps). Saves optimizer time; may need slight MUON_LR change.

title: Smaller whitening patches count
spec: In init_whiten call use train_loader.images[:480] instead of 960 to reduce SVD setup time.

title: Reduce max-autotune to default compile for forward_step
spec: Not timed compile, so no gain from this; instead try mode='max-autotune-no-cudagraphs' for forward_step and make_model to see if run time changes (cudagraph overhead/memory copies).

title: Whiten bias epochs 0.1
spec: WHITEN_BIAS_EPOCHS=0.1 so whiten bias grad stops sooner (less backward work and a second compiled graph variant).

title: Wider final block, narrower first conv group
spec: Change widths to block1=48, block2=256, block3=320. Reduces the expensive full-resolution convs in block1 while adding capacity in the cheap 4x4 resolution stage. Check that the Dirac init and Muon padding still work (max_K is derived automatically).

title: Remove first-block second conv pooling order
spec: Move max pool after the norm+activation in ConvGroup (conv->norm->act->pool) for block1 only? Instead simpler: apply activ before pool is equivalent for monotone; skip. Actual change: replace SiLU with GELU in ConvGroup to test faster fused kernel.

title: Remove color jitter
spec: Set the color_jitter enabled flag to False in train(). This removes the batch_color_jitter kernel launch and its memory traffic on the full dataset each epoch. For a 7-epoch run, little regularization is needed, so accuracy may hold.

title: Progressive resolution fixed: 24px first third
spec: Replace the 28x28 interpolation (which crashed earlier) with F.interpolate to size (24,24) for step < total_train_steps/3. Use mode='bilinear', antialias=False. Do the interpolation inside the loader on the whole epoch's tensor, once per epoch, to avoid dynamic-shape recompiles. Remove the old 28x28 block first. Cache size limit is already 64, so two input shapes are fine. Note that the max pool(3) at the end must still work: 24 input gives 23 after whiten, 11, 5, 2 and then pool 3 gives 0, so instead use AdaptiveMaxPool2d(1) for the last pool, or use 28 only.

title: EMA-free: flip every epoch random on half
spec: Replace alternating flip with per-epoch fixed flip but also keep batch_flip_lr pre-flip only; remove the pre-flip pass for epoch 0 by using images directly (saves one pass). Implement by skipping batch_flip_lr and letting alternating flip do all flipping.

title: BatchNorm momentum 0.45
spec: Change the BatchNorm default momentum argument from 0.5566 to 0.45 (the class uses 1-momentum as the torch momentum). Faster running-stat adaptation near the end of a short run may improve eval accuracy at no cost.

title: Lower resolution via channel-last half-res first block
spec: Keep the architecture but compute the first ConvGroup on 2x average-pooled whitened features for the first 30 percent of steps. This is not simple to implement, so alternatively use a random-resized-crop-free change: for step < 0.3*total_train_steps feed 28x28 center-cropped (not interpolated) inputs, inputs[:, :, 2:30, 2:30]. Final MaxPool2d(3) still works (27 whiten, 13, 6, 3, 1).

title: Non-linear LR decay power
spec: Change the LR factors in the training loop from the linear 1 - step/total to (1 - step/total) ** 1.3 for both lr_factor1 (whiten bias) and lr_factor2. Keep the same final value of zero. Using a bit more decay early may improve final accuracy, which can be traded for time.

title: Progressive resolution
spec: For the first 40 percent of steps, downsample training batches to 24x24 via F.interpolate (bilinear, antialias off) and then use full 32x32 afterwards. The net is fully convolutional up to the MaxPool(3) and head, but final spatial size changes, so use adaptive max pooling to 1x1 for the final pool. Cuts early compute.

title: Reduce translate to 1
spec: Set TRANSLATE=1, which gives less aggressive augmentation and may help in short training of 7.65 epochs.

title: Batch size 1024
spec: Set BATCH_SIZE=1024 and reduce MUON_LR to 0.18 and the head and bias LRs by 10 percent. More steps per epoch may allow fewer epochs, e.g. EPOCHS=7.0.

title: Cheaper first block: width 48
spec: Change widths block1 from 64 to 48 (the Dirac init handles in<out). Block 1 runs at the highest resolution so this saves compute.

title: Nonzero weight decay on Muon
spec: Raise WEIGHT_DECAY from 1.04e-6 to 5e-6 to test regularisation in the final phase.

title: Muon momentum warmup
spec: Ramp MUON_MOMENTUM from 0.5 to 0.7 over the first 30 percent of steps (set group['momentum'] each step in the training loop), keeping the final value near 0.655.

title: Three-stage progressive resolution 16/24/32
spec: In train(), replace the single 24x24 stage with three stages: for step < 0.25*total_train_steps interpolate inputs to 16x16 (bilinear, antialias=False); for step < 0.55*total_train_steps interpolate to 24x24; otherwise full 32x32. Everything else unchanged. Compilation of extra shapes is untimed since the warmup call runs the same schedule.

title: Low-res phase at 20x20 for first 40%
spec: Change the interpolation size in the low-res phase from (24,24) to (20,20) while keeping the 0.4 threshold. Pooling shapes still work (20->10->5->2).

title: Random-flip replaced by mixed shorter crops: translate applied only in late phase
spec: Set translation augmentation off for the low-res phase: in CifarLoader.__iter__, when epoch index is < 3, skip batch_crop and use the unpadded flipped images; after that use the translate crop. Saves some gather time and lets early epochs fit faster, while later epochs regularise.

title: Lower-precision-free speedup: drop test-time TTA to flip-only for uncertain 25%
spec: In _get_tta_logits, use only base_views = images_batch (no translated crops), so combined_inputs is the image and its flip (2 views instead of 6). This cuts the predict time, which is included in timing, at a small accuracy cost.

title: Longer decay floor
spec: Make LR decay linear to zero over total_train_steps but with the final 10 percent of steps at lower constant factor 0.02 ... simplified: lr_factor2 = max(1 - step*base, 0.0) squared mix with linear: 0.5*(linear)+0.5*(linear**2).

title: Short LR warmup
spec: Multiply lr_factor2 by min(1, (step+1)/(0.05*total_train_steps)) for the first 5% of steps (applied to all groups except the whiten bias schedule), allowing a possibly higher MUON_LR of 0.23 to be stable. Keep linear decay otherwise.

title: Drop final-epoch augmentation
spec: For the last 15% of training steps, skip color jitter and use the translate-free image: in train loop, when step >= 0.85*total_train_steps, set train_loader.aug['color_jitter']['enabled']=False at the start of each epoch (check at epoch loop top via step). Reduces train/test mismatch at the end of training for a small accuracy gain.

title: Block3 width 320 with block2 256
spec: Change widths to block1=64, block2=256, block3=320. The final block runs at 4x4 resolution so is cheap; extra capacity may raise accuracy more than it costs in time. Head input adjusts automatically via widths['block3'].

title: Cosine-ish LR decay shape
spec: Replace the linear decay factor lr_factor2 with a decay that holds near 1 longer, e.g. lr_factor2 = 1 - (step/total)**1.5 (also for the whiten bias lr if desired). Retains zero at the end.

title: Combine low-res no-translate with Muon momentum warmup
spec: Two changes: (1) Muon momentum warmup: in the training loop before the optimizer step, set optimizer2.param_groups[0]['momentum'] = 0.5 + (MUON_MOMENTUM-0.5)*min(1, step/(0.3*total_train_steps)). (2) In CifarLoader.__iter__ nothing else changes. Combines the two best near-misses (slot 5 and slot 8 ideas) by only adding the warmup on top of the incumbent.

title: Head scale tweak
spec: Change the output scaling self.head(x)/x.size(-1) to self.head(x)*(1.0/x.size(-1))*1.5 hmm implement as division by x.size(-1)/1.5 and lower HEAD_LR accordingly to 0.45 to test logit scale.

title: Label smoothing 0.12
spec: Change LABEL_SMOOTHING from 0.09 to 0.12. Slightly stronger smoothing may help the short-training regime's generalisation; no other changes.

title: Whiten bias training shorter plus SGD momentum 0.9
spec: Set WHITEN_BIAS_EPOCHS from 0.2 to 0.1 and SGD_MOMENTUM from 0.825 to 0.9 with HEAD_LR and BIAS_LR multiplied by 0.8 to compensate for the effective step growth. A bold combined change to the non-Muon optimiser group.

title: Remove colour jitter
spec: In train(), set aug color_jitter enabled to False (or set BRIGHTNESS and CONTRAST to 0 and skip the call). Removes an elementwise pass per epoch and regularisation that may be unnecessary at only ~7.65 epochs.

title: Raise TTA quantile to 40%
spec: Change UNCERTAIN_QUANTILE from 0.25 to 0.4 so more test images get multi-view averaging. This tests whether the accuracy gain outweighs the extra time.

title: No translation in final epochs
spec: In CifarLoader.__iter__ skip batch_crop and use the unpadded flipped images when self.epoch >= 6 (the last ~1.5 epochs). Less augmentation at the end of training can raise final accuracy.

title: Ensemble flipped logits in all test images
spec: Change the TTA first pass to use mirror averaging (net(x)+net(x.flip(-1)))/2 for all test images before choosing the uncertain ones, and lower UNCERTAIN_QUANTILE to 0.15 to compensate.

title: Drop TTA quantile to 15%
spec: In predict's tta function change UNCERTAIN_QUANTILE from 0.25 to 0.15 to cut the time spent on 6-view TTA at test time. Accuracy may drop slightly; check the net cost.

title: Convex LR tail
spec: Change lr_factor2 to (1 - step/total_train_steps)**1.3 so the decay is steeper early and gentler late. Keep the other settings.

title: Remove color jitter
spec: Disable color jitter (set enabled False) to skip the compiled jitter kernel and save time. Check whether the accuracy loss is small.

title: Progressive resolution early epochs
spec: In train(), for the first ~35% of steps downsample each training batch to 24x24 with F.interpolate (bilinear, antialias off) before the model, then use full 32x32 afterwards. The network is fully convolutional up to the final MaxPool2d(3) and flatten, so the flatten size changes: make the final pooling adaptive (nn.AdaptiveMaxPool2d(1) equivalent at 32 res gives 3x3->1x1 after pool(3); use AdaptiveMaxPool2d(1) in place of MaxPool2d(3)) so both resolutions work. Mark forward_step with dynamic=False; it will compile two shapes, which is untimed. Keep total epochs unchanged; the aim is cheaper early steps.

title: Remove block3 second conv's width: 192
spec: Change widths to block1=64, block2=256, block3=192. This lowers the cost of the last block's convs (conv1 256->192, conv2 192->192) and the head input. The head scale uses x.size(-1) so it adapts automatically. Everything else unchanged.

title: Label smoothing decay to zero
spec: Make label smoothing a function of progress: pass a tensor or python float into forward_step changing from 0.15 at start to 0.02 at the end, linearly in step. To avoid recompiles, pass it as a 0-d CUDA tensor and compute the loss manually: logp=F.log_softmax(outputs.float(),1); loss = -((1-s)*logp.gather(1,labels[:,None]).squeeze(1) + s*logp.mean(1)).sum().

title: Channels-last bf16-free: CUDA graphs for the train step
spec: Change forward_step compile mode from 'max-autotune' to 'max-autotune-no-cudagraphs' is not the point; instead use torch.compile(mode='max-autotune') as is, but also compile the whole Muon update by wrapping the foreach momentum/nesterov/update code in a single torch.compile'd function taking lists of tensors (the norm scaling branch computed every step by a Python flag passed as a constant). This reduces Python and kernel-launch overhead per step, which matters at ~25 steps per epoch.

title: Block2 and block3 width 224
spec: Change widths block2 and block3 from 256 to 224 to reduce FLOPs by about 20 percent in the heavy blocks. Raise EPOCHS to 8.0 if needed.

title: Block1 width 48
spec: Change widths block1 from 64 to 48. This is a narrower first block, so the first conv layers run faster at full resolution. Check the accuracy impact.

title: Weight decay increase
spec: Raise WEIGHT_DECAY from 1.04e-06 to 3e-06 and check for regularization benefit.

title: Lower low-res size to 20x20 early
spec: In train(), use a three-stage resolution schedule: for step < 0.2*total_train_steps interpolate inputs to 20x20, for step < 0.5*total_train_steps to 24x24, else full 32x32. Keep the bilinear interpolate and channels_last contiguous call. Each new shape triggers one extra compile, which is not timed.

title: Block3 width 192 plus fused Muon momentum
spec: Combine the two earlier near-noise wins: set widths block3 to 192, and fuse Muon's momentum-buffer update and Nesterov combination into one torch.compile'd helper function. Both only cut compute, so they should stack on the progressive-resolution base.

title: Two Newton-Schulz iterations
spec: In _zeropower_via_newtonschulz5 remove the third unrolled iteration (the A, B, X update) so only 2 iterations run. This saves optimizer time. Check whether accuracy holds.

title: Cutout regularisation, small patches
spec: Add a batched random cutout of 8x8 zeroed on the normalised images, applied to half the samples in the loader, inside a compiled function like batch_color_jitter. Raising regularisation could permit fewer epochs (EPOCHS 7.0) at the same accuracy.

title: Translate 1 augmentation
spec: Set TRANSLATE from 2 to 1. The smaller pad shrinks the cached padded image and gather cost, and less translation may suit a short 7.65-epoch schedule. Check the TTA code still works, since it uses its own pad=1.

title: Test-time TTA with one fewer view
spec: In _get_tta_logits drop the crop_br and its flipped view, using only images_batch, crop_tl and their flips (4 views instead of 6). This cuts TTA compute by a third on 25% of the test set, saving predict time; accuracy loss is expected to be tiny. Update the num_views computation (already derived from shapes).

title: Low-res size 28 for late phase ramp
spec: Use a two-stage progressive resolution schedule: 24x24 for the first 30% of steps, 28x28 (bilinear, antialias=False) for the next 30%, then full 32x32. Add the new interpolate branch in the training loop. Each distinct shape triggers one extra untimed compile, which is fine.
